088604c0.title: Solutions Architect II - IAM
088604c0.description:
You may know McCormick as a leader in herbs, spices, seasonings, and condiments – and we’re only getting started. At McCormick, we’re always looking for new people to bring their unique flavor to our team.
   

  

 McCormick employees – all 14,000 of us across the world – are what makes this company a great place to work.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Solution Architect is accountable for defining and owning the architecture strategy and multi\-year technology roadmap for IAM. This role leads the development of IAM conceptual and logical architectures, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with enterprise standards and business objectives.
   

  

 Acting as the primary architectural authority for IAM, the Solution Architect partners closely with IT \& Cybersecurity management, engineering, security and infrastructure teams to translate business capabilities into cohesive technology designs. The role provides architectural direction throughout the product lifecycle, guiding solution decisions, governing adherence to standards, and identifying opportunities to enhance security, modernize platforms, reduce technical debt, and enable future innovation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Works on complex projects that require in\-depth knowledge of all IAM capabilities within their architecture domain, providing architectural designs and guidance.
* Provides direction, guidance, and definition of IT/Security architecture to effectively support the product and business strategy. Supports IAM architecture discipline and champions’ architectural initiatives according to the corporate standards.
* Consults with project teams to fit projects to established architecture patterns, as well as to identify when it is necessary to modify the standard architectural patterns. Ensures the conceptual completeness of the technical solutions.
* Participates in the creation of governing principles and standards to guide architecture decision making. Identifies exceptions to architectural standards at an enterprise level and facilitates resolution. Reviews and/or analyzes and develops architectural and security requirements as needed for the organization.
* Performs research on emerging technologies in support of systems development efforts and recommend technologies that will improve cost effectiveness and systems flexibility. Develop, document, and communicate plans for investing in systems architecture, including analysis of cost reduction opportunities.
* Aligns to the regulatory and compliance frameworks and processes of the Company, maintains a risk mindset.
* Maintain continuous personal learning and development to remain technological relevancy in current and emerging areas.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity or relevant field.
* 8\+ Years of IAM experience, with a significant amount of time spent in an engineering / architecture role for IGA, PAM, Secrets Management, Directory Services, Cloud and other capabilities of a holistic IAM program
* Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal skills needed to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Proven track record of designing highly complex global architecture designs.
* Experience of participating in complex global projects, processes, and systems.


 We understand that not everyone will match each of the above qualifications. However, we also realize that everyone has unique experiences that can add value to our company. Even if you think your background might not perfectly align, we'd love to hear from you!
   

  

 At McCormick \& Company, our inclusive culture speaks for itself. Here are a few of our awards:
   

  

* Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces
* 100 Best companies to work for
* Diversity MBA’s 50 Out Front: Best Places to Work for Women \& Diverse Managers.


 McCormick \& Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 As a general policy, McCormick does not offer employment visa sponsorships upon hire or in the future.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level: Senior Consultant**
**Work you’ll do:**
 As a Consultant in our Cyber Application Security team, you will be part of our Oracle practice and will be responsible for delivering Oracle security and controls implementations services across a varied format of architectures. Responsibilities will include assessment, design and implementation of security and controls on cloud\-based Oracle environment to secure this environment.
   

  

 The key job responsibilities will be to:
   

  

* Design, and implement customized, scalable and SOX compliant security solutions
* Lead requirements gathering, design documentation by conducting client workshops in onsite/offshore delivery model for projects
* Advanced debugging and troubleshoot issues, including interacting with technology vendors
* Architect, design and implement the SSO solutions for various Oracle SaaS/PaaS services
* Configure security for Oracle PaaS services (OIC, VBCS, FAW)
* Implement security in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure by designing groups using the security principle of least privilege
* Design, customize and implement Oracle Cloud Guard and Data Safe as part of Governance, Risk and Compliance solution
* Support security and compliance activities by identifying and driving initiatives that are relevant for the project delivery and help factor reusability and related benefits.


**The team**
 Deloitte Cyber Risk team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive Secure. Vigilant. Resilient. Cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* 5\+ years of experience delivering full cycle of Oracle Cloud IaaS and PaaS security assessments, design, and implementations as well as understanding of leading practices relates to IaaS and PaaS security
* Understanding of Identity and Access Management concepts, Single Sign\-On and API authentication mechanisms, cloud security posture management

* Experience in coordinating with development teams, functional teams, business leads, information security \& risk management teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Good project management and organizational skills


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Experience in Oracle IaaS and PaaS security
* Experience in Oracle Identity Domains
* Previous Consulting or Big 4 experience preferred
* Security Certifications such as: CISSP, CCSP, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Certification is a plus
* Automation using Terraform, Python, or VBA

c59790f4.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence \& Engineering**
 AI \& Engineering leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission\-critical operations.
   

  

 Join our AI \& Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re\-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

**Level: Associate Architect**
 As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

 As a Cloud Strategy practitioner, you will be responsible for working collaboratively within integrated cross functional teams to deliver comprehensive strategies that enable Cloud and Infrastructure Transformations.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 Lead discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on business architecture. Prepare technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create and enforce technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, manage deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross\-functional teams. Design templates or scripts to automate routine development or operational tasks.
   

  

* Expertise in J2EE and Spring Boot:
* Strong proficiency in Java/J2EE frameworks, with a focus on Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Cloud.
* Extensive experience in developing scalable, high\-performance enterprise applications using J2EE.
* Cloud Computing (AWS/Azure):
* Deep understanding and hands\-on experience with AWS (EC2, ECS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation) or Azure (App Services, Kubernetes Service, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB, Azure Functions).
* Proficiency in designing and deploying microservices architectures on cloud platforms.
* Microservices Architecture:
* Strong expertise in building and managing microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud Netflix (Eureka, Hystrix, Zuul, Ribbon), and REST/GraphQL APIs.
* Experience with inter\-service communication using gRPC or Kafka.
* Performance Optimization:
* Proven experience in profiling, monitoring, and optimizing applications for performance using tools like JMeter, Java Flight Recorder..
* Expertise in JVM tuning, memory management, and SQL query optimization.
* DevOps Practices and CI/CD:
* Hands\-on experience with DevOps tools and methodologies, including:
* CI/CD tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline.
* Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible.
* Monitoring tools: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk.
* Database and Data Storage:
* Expertise in relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and SQL Server.
* Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, DynamoDB, or Cosmos DB.
* Code Reviews and Best Practices:
* Expertise in conducting thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to SOLID principles, design patterns, and industry\-standard best practices.
* Proficiency in writing clean, modular, and maintainable code using tools like SonarQube or PMD for static code analysis.
* API Management and Security:
* Experience in designing and managing APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, or API Gateway.
* Knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols like OAuth2, JWT, and SAML.
* System Architecture and Design:
* Strong experience in architecting scalable, distributed systems using microservices, event\-driven architectures, and domain\-driven design (DDD).
* Proficiency in creating technical design documents and architectural diagrams using tools like Visio, Lucidchart, or Archimate.
* Continuous Learning and Collaboration:
* Commitment to staying updated with the latest advancements in Java, J2EE, and cloud\-native technologies.
* Excellent collaboration skills with cross\-functional teams (Product, QA, DevOps) to ensure alignment and deliver high\-quality solutions.


**The team:**
 Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering\-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* 7 \- 12 years of industry experience, with at least 6\+ years in a technical architect role designing applications and hosting solutions as public/private cloud SaaS PaaS platforms.
* At least 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud native architecture design, implementation of distributed, fault\-tolerant enterprise applications for cloud.
* Should have knowledge to understand and create the Target State Solutions.
* Should be able to create Low level designs for Engineering teams For Ex: Flow charts, Sequence diagrams, class diagrams.
* Should have knowledge of reusable components\- Filters, JPA, Logging and Monitoring.
* Should have Hands\-On experience on
* Spring web\-Java API development along with certification process
* Maven build Tools
* Spring JPA, connection pool configuration
* Event Driven Implementation: Kafka connector library Integration with Java.
* Should have good knowledge of SOLID principles and Java Design Pattern
* Should define Interfaces and re\-usable components to avoid duplicate effort \- For Ex: Circuit breaker, Retry, Error Handling.
* Experience in application migration and modernization of legacy applications to AWS cloud platforms.
* Familiarity of principles summarized in the AWS Cloud Adoption and Well\-Architected Frameworks
* Deep expertise of architecting and designing end\-to\-end AWS solutions architecture, recommending best cloud architecture patterns suiting the business problems, (Integrating services like: AWS API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Function, Amazon MQ, Lambda, AWS S3 and storage classes, etc.)
* Working experience of designing approach and migrating solution from on\-prem using AWS Database Migration, Migration Hub, Application Migration Service, etc.
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, EKS or OpenShift container platforms
* Working knowledge of AWS CodePipeline, CodeCommit, CodeBuild, CodeArtifact, AWS X\-Ray, IAM Policies, KMS, GuardDuty, etc.
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, design and implementation creating cloud architecture leveraging PaaS and IaaS.
* Strong understanding of the cloud native development practices and architectural patterns
* Experience in leading and managing teams within specialist areas from project planning to execution

* Understanding on network architectures including integration of software components such as web / application servers, middleware, RDBMS, development environments, operational components and data center operations

6cf09e89.title: Operations Delivery Manager
6cf09e89.description:
Operations Delivery Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Chennai
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Delivery Model:** 
 Offshore Delivery – Chennai
 



 About the Role
 



 We are hiring an Operations Delivery Manager to own end\-to\-end delivery for our Chennai offshore team – spanning service delivery, platform support, and production operations.
 



 This person will be the operational backbone connecting onshore business priorities with offshore execution, driving governance, quality, resourcing, and performance across multiple project streams.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Overall Service Delivery Management
 


* Own end\-to\-end service delivery across platform support, application support, and production operations.
* Ensure services consistently meet agreed SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, and business expectations.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and governance across support and engineering teams.
* Monitor service performance, identify operational risks, and initiate corrective actions.
* Drive operational maturity through standardization, automation, process improvement, and service optimization.
* Ensure business\-critical applications and platforms have appropriate support coverage, operational procedures, and escalation mechanisms.
* Maintain a strong focus on service availability, reliability, performance, security, and customer experience.
* Provide regular management reporting covering service health, risks, incidents, changes, capacity, and improvement initiatives.



 2\. Platform Support Management
 


* Lead the delivery and operational support of enterprise platforms across cloud, infrastructure, middleware, databases, networks, and related technology services.
* Ensure effective monitoring of platform health, availability, performance, and capacity.
* Coordinate platform teams during service degradation, outages, and performance issues.
* Review platform incidents and identify recurring infrastructure or capacity\-related problems.
* Drive platform resilience, scalability, disaster recovery, and operational excellence.



 3\. Team \& People Management
 


* Manage and grow team leads and delivery managers.
* Own capacity planning and resource allocation against shifting project demand.
* Build a culture of ownership and accountability; support career growth and succession planning.



 4\.Stakeholder Management
 


* Be the go\-to offshore contact for onshore leadership and business stakeholders.
* Lead governance calls, reporting on delivery health, risks, and wins.
* Own escalations end\-to\-end – fast resolution, clear communication.



 5\. Reporting
 


* Own weekly/monthly operational reporting: SLA adherence, delivery timelines, utilization, productivity, risk status.



 Required Experience
 


* 12–16 years in IT Operations, Service Delivery, or Technology Delivery Management.
* **Insurance Domain Experience is mandatory.**
* 6–8 years specifically managing offshore delivery teams reporting into onshore/global stakeholders.
* Proven experience owning service delivery, platform support, and production operations at scale.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery governance, incident/problem management, and KPI reporting.
* Background in software/technology services, product engineering, or insurance tech.



 Required Skills
 


* Service Delivery Management
* Platform Support \& Operations
* SLA/OLA Management
* Incident \& Problem Management
* Delivery Governance
* Team Leadership
* Capacity Planning
* Stakeholder Management
* Risk \& Escalation Management
* Process Improvement



 Preferred Certifications
 


* **PMP (Project Management Professional)** 
 – Preferred for strong project, delivery, planning, risk, budget, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* **ITIL 4 Foundation / Managing Professional** 
 – Preferred for IT service management, incident, problem, change, SLA, and service governance experience.
* **PRINCE2 Practitioner** 
 – Preferred for structured project governance, delivery controls, risk management, and organizational governance.
* **Agile / Scrum certification** 
 – Desirable for experience working in Agile, DevOps, and product\-oriented delivery environments.



 Education
 



 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business Administration. MBA or relevant certifications are a plus.

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of overall professional experience, including at least 5 years working with Finance Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting systems in enterprise environments.
* 3\+ years’ experience and proven track record in a Presales Solution Consulting role, ideally within a software/SaaS environment.
* 3\+ years extensive experience presenting to C\-level executives with the ability to communicate influentially.
* Strong understanding of the Financial Planning and Consolidation functional areas as well as Workforce Planning.


**Other Qualifications:**
* Exposure to Planning solutions from Anaplan, Onestream, IBM Planning Analytics/TM1, SAP and Oracle would be an advantage
* Knowledge of Generative and Agentic AI as applied to the Finance domain and experience in positioning embedded or built\-on\-AI solutions to business and technology stakeholders
* Experience engaging with medium and large enterprises across various industries such as FSI, Higher Education, Healthcare, Government, Professional Services and Retail.
* Experience in Workforce, Headcount, Sales and Operational Planning will be desirable.
* You are an exceptional, dynamic presenter with strong communication and influencing skills, specifically to a C\-level Finance leadership audience
* You possess credibility and passion for presentations and product demonstrations around FP\&A technology solutions

* You are a "continuous learner" who is passionate about innovation and creative problem\-solving.
* Applicants must have willingness to travel up to 50% of the time to engage with customers and partners in the field.
* You are adaptable and excited to work in a high growth, evolving organization.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 At Workday, we are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience where all candidates can fully demonstrate their skills. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point, please email accommodations@workday.com.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
 At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
   

  

 Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.

**About Us:**


We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion \& Diversity at PVH **here**.


**POSITION SUMMARY:**

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer (Web) with deep expertise in Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) and a specialization in PWA Kit / Composable Storefront. You will be responsible for designing and developing high\-performance, headless B2C eCommerce solutions.

  



The ideal candidate is an expert in React, who has been part of migration projects from different eCommerce platforms and from SFCC – SFRA into SFCC – PWA Kit, is an expert in Managed Runtime (MRT) , can establish and follow coding standards, resolve bugs, vulnerabilities created by QA and Code quality platforms tools like SonarQube, and bridge modern frontend frameworks with SFCC’s backend power.

  


**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES/ACCOUNTABILITIES OF THE JOB:**


* Develop Headless Features: Build and maintain PWA storefront features including PDP, PLP, Cart, and Checkout using the Retail React App template.


* Code Optimization: Lead the cleanup of the codebase by monitoring SonarQube reports and implementing architectural fixes to ensure high quality\-gate scores.


* API Orchestration: Implement and extend SCAPI/OCAPI integrations and handle complex data mapping between SFCC and the React frontend.


* Managed Runtime (MRT): Deploy and manage bundle versions and environment configurations within the Salesforce Managed Runtime.


* Security \& Auth: Implement secure shopper authentication using SLAS (Shopper Login and API Access Service).


* UI/UX Excellence: Translate Figma/high\-fidelity designs into responsive, accessible, and performant React components.


* Collaboration: Partner with Product, UX/UI, and Backend teams to ensure seamless end\-to\-end user journeys.


* Troubleshooting: Use SFCC Log Center, MRT logs, and browser debugging tools to resolve complex production issues.


* Team work: Participate in scrums and work with SI partners to deliver business requirements.

**INTERNAL \& EXTERNAL CONTACTS:**


* **Internal:** Works closely with business and technology teams, including engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.


* **External:** Engages with technology vendors, consultants, and industry partners to stay updated on best practices and emerging trends.


**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Direct: None


* Indirect: Provide leadership \& guidance to outsourced vendor resources


**BUDGETARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Maintain the environment to minimize budget overflows

**DECISION MAKING:**


* Leads decision\-making on data product development and prioritization in collaboration with stakeholders.


* Recommends technology investments and improvements to enhance data product capabilities.


**RESOURCEFULNESS/CREATIVITY:**


* Ensures technology solutions align with business needs, emphasizing usability, scalability, and cost\-effectiveness.


* Requires strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex business and technical challenges.


**ENVIRONMENT:** This role requires the ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities effectively. Domestic and international travel may be required.

  


**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:**

**Experience:**


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience.


* 2\+ Headless storefront implementation experience preferably with full cycle implementation of SFCC Composable storefront/PWA Kit.


* Expert\-level React knowledge, including Hooks, Context API, SSR (Server\-Side Rendering), and state management.


* Strong grasp of SFCC Core Concepts: Mastery of SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API) and OCAPI is essential.


* Code Quality Specialist: Proven experience resolving issues reported by Code quality platforms, including security vulnerabilities, code smells, and maintainability debt.


* Modern Frontend Stack: Expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, ES6\+, and Chakra UI (or similar CSS\-in\-JS libraries).


* Integration Expertise: Experience integrating with OMS, Payment Gateways (via SLAS), and third\-party services in a decoupled environment.


* Performance Mindset: Strong understanding of Core Web Vitals, Service Workers, and caching strategies within Managed Runtime.


* Agile/Scrum: Experience delivering scalable UI within fast\-paced Agile environments.

  


 

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree required, in any relevant business, liberal arts, STEM, or technology/engineering disciplines

  



 **Skills:**


* SFCC PWA Kit and Composable Storefront.


* Experience with 3rd Party tools like Optimizely, Content stack


* Experience with Mocha for automated testing.


* Knowledge of traditional SFRA (to assist in migration/logic extraction).


* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.


* Languages: JavaScript (ES6\+), TypeScript, JSON, SCSS.


* SFCC: PWA Kit, Composable Storefront, SCAPI, OCAPI, Business Manager, SLAS.


* Frontend: React (Expert), TypeScript, Node.js, CSS\-in\-JS (Chakra UI).


* Quality/DevOps: SonarQube, Git, Jira, Postman, Managed Runtime (MRT).


* Legacy Systems: SFRA, ISML (understanding required for migration logic).


* Note: **Apex\-only or traditional SFRA\-only profiles are NOT suitable;** this role requires deep React and Headless\-specific SFCC experience.  Please find the JD below:
   

  

 Salesforce\- Technical Architect/ Senior Technical Architect
   

  

 The Senior Technical Architect is responsible for successfully designing and managing the successful delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies. You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

 What You'll Actually Be Doing:
   

  

 \- Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
   

 \- Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
   

 \- Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits

 \- Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
   

 \- Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
   

 \- Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
   

 \- From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
   

 \- Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
   

 \- Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%
   

  

 You're Our Person If...
   

  

 \- Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
   

 \- 10\+ years of overall experience with a minimum of 8 years on the Salesforce platform
   

 \- Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Data Cloud, Industry Clouds, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and familiarity with Agentforce
   

 \- Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
   

 \- Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model

d3cb92b5.description:
FireMon has learned an unknown and unauthorized third party is impersonating FireMon HR as part of a phishing attempt. Communications from FireMon will always originate from the FireMon.com domain. FireMon will never ask for any banking information as part of an interview process. If you are concerned whether a communication from FireMon is legitimate, please contact us at \[email protected]
   

  

 FireMon is a recognized innovator in global cybersecurity, leading the way with disruptive technologies and forward\-thinking solutions. Here, proactive thinking is not just encouraged—it’s celebrated. Our fast\-paced, cutting\-edge environment fuels continuous innovation, shaping how we build products, support customers, and drive results every day.
   

  

 The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a technical resource who advocates for designated customers and ensures customers' needs are known and managed across all offerings, including services, training, support, and product development. The TAM prioritizes customers' technical issues and communicates those priorities to support; communicates the status of services projects; conveys the needs and urgency of RFEs to product management and contributes to the product roadmap.
   

  

 You will provide customers with status updates of open tickets and development/services projects; the upcoming release schedule; issues trending; upgrade recommendations; and guidance through early access/beta programs. This role will also require periodic onsite visits.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Manage overall relationships with assigned end\-users, including increasing adoption, and ensuring retention and satisfaction.
* Provide project leadership for customers' major FireMon programs.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with FireMon teams—including Support, R\&D, Product Management, and Sales—to address customer needs and deliver high\-impact outcomes.
* Management, and Sales, on customers' technical issues and projects.
* Maintain current functional and technical knowledge of the FireMon product line.
* Provide hands\-on support to customers for system health checks, user and device management, troubleshooting, upgrades, and monitoring activities.
* Manage multiple customer engagements, balancing priorities and driving resolution across requests.
* Share insights and constructive feedback with internal teams to help improve products and customer experiences.
* Document best practices in developing and deploying FireMon solutions in the customers' environments.
* Be a technical resource for "best practice" and other customer questions, identifying alternate technical solutions to customers' business problems.
* Partner with account teams to manage expectations and provide a clear view of customer progress and health throughout their lifecycle.
* Commit to continuous learning by maintaining relevant certifications and gaining new ones each year.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or another related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in roles such as technical project management, technical account management, professional services, or similar customer\-facing technical roles.
* Three or more years of experience managing or architecting complex network infrastructures. This includes the architecture, design, implementation, troubleshooting, and ongoing support of router/switch\-based and software\-defined virtual networks.
* Experience in client\-server applications, Unix/Linux system administration, or software development. Experience includes debugging and troubleshooting, upgrading software, and applying security patches.
* At least one active technical certification (e.g., CCNA or equivalent), with a willingness to pursue additional certifications annually as part of your professional growth.
* Understanding of modern software development methodologies, including infrastructure design and architecture best practices.
* Proven success in customer\-facing roles—especially in implementation, or support settings—where communication and relationship\-building were key.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to balance technical detail and customer impact.
* Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple customer needs at once.
* Effective communicator with the ability to engage stakeholders across various roles—from hands\-on technical teams to mid\-level managers and senior IT leadership (CISO/CIO/CTO level) in enterprise environments.


**What it Takes to be Part of the FireMon Team**
 FireMon provides persistent network security for hybrid environments through a powerful fusion of real\-time asset visibility, continuous compliance, and automation. Since creating the first\-ever network security policy management solution, FireMon has delivered command and control over complex network security infrastructures for more than 1,700 customers.
   

  

 Our customers have unique and complex security problems that are difficult to solve. This doesn’t intimidate us, it inspires us. It pushes us to be more creative and find solutions to ensure their success. If this sounds like a movement you'd be interested in joining, we invite you to apply today.
   

  

 FireMon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees, and applicants for employment, and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Own end\-to\-end execution of multiple customer programs within the OSAT business unit.

* Develop and maintain integrated program schedules, milestones, and deliverables.

81b4818b.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
81b4818b.description:
**Summary**
 Guidewire provides outstanding software for the second\-largest financial services industry in the world: insurance. We deliver the core applications that Property and Casualty (P/C) insurers use to build their products, sell policies, settle claims, and bill their customers. We deliver SaaS solutions via Guidewire Cloud that enable our customers to rapidly innovate and drive measurable value. Our Application Platform helps internal developers and customers build innovative insurance applications with the aim to boost developer productivity, establish a vendor ecosystem and leverage the latest cloud technologies.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager, you will play a key role within Application Platform organization, driving projects internally (and with other teams). You will be responsible to drive and coordinate major platform and cloud service initiatives with the highest degree of complexity. Your impact will be felt across the organization. You will spend a significant proportion of your time developing the capabilities of the team as a whole.
   

  

**Job Description**
 What you’ll do
   

  

* Lead end‑to‑end planning and execution of complex, multi‑team technical programs across platform, cloud operations, product engineering, data, and security to support PDO’s goals in reliability, security, and gross margin improvement.
* Partner with engineering, product management, design, QA, business stakeholders, and infrastructure teams to define scope, problem statements, success metrics, and delivery milestones for initiatives such as GenAI “lifts,” cloud reliability improvements, and new platform capabilities.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously refine integrated program plans—including timelines, dependency maps, risk registers, and release plans—to ensure programs land on time, within scope, and with clearly defined business outcomes.
* Manage cross‑functional dependencies, proactively identify and remove blockers, and escalate risks with data‑driven options so teams can move quickly while maintaining quality, compliance, and customer trust.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies, technical deep dives, architecture and design discussions, and regular program syncs that align teams around priorities, trade‑offs, and delivery commitments across loosely coupled domains.
* Implement and evolve program governance, reporting cadences, and operational best practices that improve transparency, decision‑making, and execution efficiency across PDO and partner organizations.
* Define and own program‑level KPIs (e.g., reliability, incident metrics, development velocity, technical debt reduction, cloud and data platform adoption, infrastructure stability), track variances, and drive course‑corrections based on data and continuous feedback.
* Ensure technical readiness for production releases—including security posture, scalability, performance, disaster recovery dependencies, and operational health—aligned with Guidewire’s security and compliance standards.
* Collaborate with leadership to drive change management, refine processes, and align programs with Guidewire’s broader vision to embed AI and GenAI across products and operations, including initiatives like the Agentic AI Platform and cloud adoption accelerators.
* Influence platform and tooling direction by identifying opportunities to streamline developer workflows, improve operational efficiency, and better support AI, cloud, and data platform adoption across PDO and other teams.
* Manage relationships with vendors and third‑party service providers where applicable, including contract and SLA considerations, to ensure external dependencies support program outcomes and service reliability.
* Act as the “glue” that connects high‑velocity, distributed teams, ensuring alignment with Guidewire’s mission to transform how P\&C insurers operate through a secure, scalable, AI‑enabled cloud platform.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data\-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 12\+ years of total professional experience, including 5\+ years in technical program management driving complex, multi‑team software initiatives, preferably in cloud, infrastructure, or platform environments.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and agile or hybrid delivery models, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, operations, and security teams.
* Solid grasp of modern software architecture, cloud systems (e.g., distributed, multi‑tenant SaaS), and platform engineering concepts such as reliability, observability, and scalability.
* Proven track record of designing and running metrics‑driven programs: defining KPIs, building dashboards or reporting mechanisms, and using data to guide decisions, communicate impact, and improve program performance.
* Hands‑on experience with engineering planning and tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, Aha!, Confluence, Google Sheets) to manage backlogs, dependencies, and status reporting at scale.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex technical topics for executives and non‑technical partners, and to drive alignment among diverse viewpoints.
* Proficiency with change management principles and techniques—able to guide teams through new processes, tools, and ways of working while minimizing disruption and resistance.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data\-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience**
* Experience leading programs related to cloud operations, platform reliability, AI/ML or GenAI features, or large‑scale data platforms.
* Background in or exposure to P\&C insurance or other highly regulated industries, particularly in cloud or SaaS environments.
* Experience with vendor management, including understanding of SLAs, contract implications, and how external partners fit into critical program paths.
* Prior experience in organizations undergoing significant cloud, AI, or data platform transformation, especially where operational excellence and innovation must be balanced.
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field—or equivalent demonstrated technical proficiency through experience.


 Your Impact
   

  

 We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first months, you’ll immerse yourself in PDO’s FY26 VPMOM, understand our AI, cloud, and data platform priorities, and take ownership of one or more high‑impact programs—such as reliability and security improvements, GenAI‑enabled product capabilities, or cross‑region disaster recovery and readiness initiatives.
   

  

 You’ll establish program structures, clarify goals and KPIs, and build trusted relationships with engineering, product, security, operations, and go‑to‑market leaders. As your programs mature, you’ll be accountable for measurable outcomes like improved service reliability, faster time‑to‑market for AI‑infused features, increased adoption of cloud and data platform capabilities, and reduced operational toil. Your work will directly support Guidewire’s mission to combine digital, core, analytics, and AI into a cloud platform that helps P\&C insurers operate more efficiently and deliver better experiences to their customers worldwide.
   

  

**About Guidewire**
 Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
   

  

 As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.
   

  

 Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

c45cea7d.description:
**Bring more to life.**

  

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

  

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

  

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1\.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

  

This position of cybersecurity architect is for Beckman Coulter team located at Danaher India Development Center (IDC), Bangalore and will be an on\-site role.


IDC is a research and development center with the vision of accelerating product roadmaps across various Danaher business segments. Started in 2014, the center now hosts 500\+ associates, for multiple Danaher operating companies focusing on Diagnostics and Life Science. The operating companies includes Beckman Coulter, Radiometer, Leica Bio systems, HemoCue, Cepheid and more.


The IDC workforce comprises of various product engineering teams, working on development of software and hardware components of cutting\-edge products for, Immunoassay, Chemistry, Hematology, Molecular diagnostics, Oncology, Neurosurgery and Water Quality. IDC has evolved as center of excellence for Cloud and data analytics, with significant contributions to the key informatics solutions. The teams consist of highly hardworking software \& hardware engineers and development managers. The teams are supported by local Product managers, Quality \& Regulatory and Intellectual property specialists.

  

At Beckman Coulter, our vision is to relentlessly reimagine healthcare, one diagnosis at a time.

  

You will report to the Sr. Manager Product Cybersecurity Architect within Global Product Security (GPS). If you are passionate about building security into products from day one, and you thrive in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven technology environment, read on.

 **In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Assist in identifying and tracking potential security risks throughout the product lifecycle and help perform threat modeling and security reviews for new product features.
* Support vulnerability management efforts by learning how to triage, prioritize, and follow up on findings.
* Help generate and manage Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) and understand their role in supply chain security.
* Assist with the Government Authority to Operate (ATO) process, including preparation of security documentation, coordination with stakeholders, and support during security assessments and authorization activities.
* Support implementation and validation of DoD Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) by conducting system hardening, security configuration reviews, and compliance checks to ensure alignment with Department of Defense security requirements.

 **The essential requirements of the job include:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 2\-3 years of experience in Cybersecurity activities related to Threat Model, Risk Assessment, Vulnerability assessment.
* Understanding software development lifecycle (SDLC), secure code practice and CI\-CD.
* Familiarity with common security concepts like authentication, encryption, OWASP Top 10, and secure coding practices.
* Basic scripting knowledge and exposure to AI tools.

 **It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Experience with medical devices, regulated technologies, or safety\-critical systems.
* Training towards certifications from ISC2, EC Council, CSA or equivalent.
* Experience working within Agile or DevSecOps development environments.

  

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

0838d637.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Infiniband and Networking Ethernet - NVIS
0838d637.description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large\-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real\-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.
* Provide feedback to internal teams such as opening bugs, documenting workarounds, and suggesting improvements.


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields.
* At least 5\+ years of professional experience in networking fundamentals, Ethernet or InfiniBand World.
* Hands\-on experience with network switch/router platforms like Cumulus Linux, SONiC, IOS, JunosOS, and EOS, etc.
* Possess solid working knowledge of Ethernet/InfiniBand/RDMA core principles.
* Be proficient in end\-to\-end IB/Eth cluster deployment, adapter configuration and firmware maintenance, and able to conduct professional performance benchmarking with mainstream RDMA testing tools.
* Capable of independently diagnosing and troubleshooting typical IB/Eth network anomalies, including link flapping, connection failure, as well as bandwidth and latency jitter issues.
* Master practical RDMA network optimization strategies such as QP tuning, MTU configuration and congestion control optimization.
* Hands\-on working experience in RDMA\-accelerated business scenarios, including distributed storage and high\-performance computing clusters.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning solutions using tools like Ansible, Salt, and Python.
* Ability to develop CI/CD pipelines for network operations.
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are essential.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Familiarity with cloud networks (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus.
* Advanced Linux or Networking Certifications.
* Experience with High\-performance computing architectures. Understanding of how job schedulers(Slurm, PBS) work.
* luster management technologies knowledge (bonus credit for BCM (Base Command Manager).)
* Experience with GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) focused hardware/software.

fd2412b5.title: Tender BID Manager- GEM EPROC
fd2412b5.description:
**Company:** Urban Dienst LLP  
**Location:** Sector 132, Noida, Uttar Pradesh (on\-site)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** \[2–5] years in government tendering / bid management

About Urban Dienst LLP

Urban Dienst LLP is an Indian technology company working in drones, AI and engineering infrastructure projects. We supply products and services to government departments and PSUs through the GeM portal and other public procurement channels.

Role Overview

We are looking for a detail\-oriented Bid Manager to run our tendering from start to finish. This includes finding the right opportunities, preparing compliant bid documents, submitting them on time, and tracking every bid until it is awarded. You will coordinate with internal teams, OEMs and vendors so that every submission is complete and accurate.

Key Responsibilities

**Tender Identification and Screening**

* Monitor GeM, CPPP (eprocure.gov.in), defence and PSU e\-procurement portals, and state tender sites every day for relevant opportunities.
* Review tender documents and shortlist bids that fit the company's products, services and eligibility.
* Summarise key terms for management, including scope, eligibility, EMD, deadlines, technical specifications and penalty clauses.

**Bid Preparation and Documentation**

* Prepare technical and commercial bid documents according to each tender's eligibility and requirements.
* Collect and maintain supporting documents, such as:
* Company registrations and financial statements
* Experience certificates and work orders
* OEM authorisations
* Make in India / local content declarations
* MSE/Startup exemption certificates
* Prepare compliance statements, technical data sheets and all required declarations and formats.
* Arrange EMD, bid security declarations and performance bank guarantees as required.

**Bid Submission and Tracking**

* Upload and submit bids on the portals before deadlines, using Digital Signature Certificates (DSC).
* Track the status of every tender daily, including clarifications, corrigenda, technical evaluation, reverse auctions and financial bid opening.
* Respond to queries raised by buyers and evaluation committees within the deadlines.
* Keep a live tender tracker with deadlines, bid status, results and competitor pricing where available.

**Coordination**

* Coordinate with the technical, finance and management teams to get inputs, pricing approvals and documents on time.
* Liaise with OEMs, vendors and partners for quotations, authorisations and technical compliance.
* Support post\-award activities, including contract acceptance, delivery documentation, inspection coordination and invoice/payment follow\-up on GeM.

**Records and Compliance**

* Maintain an organised, up\-to\-date library of company documents and past bids for quick reuse.
* Keep registrations on GeM and other portals active, including vendor profiles, catalogues and brand/OEM approvals.
* Stay up to date on procurement rules, GFR provisions, GeM policies and Make in India / public procurement orders.

Requirements

* Graduate in any discipline. A background in engineering, commerce or business management is preferred.
* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience with GeM and other government tender portals.
* Strong understanding of tender processes, including:
* Eligibility criteria
* EMD/PBG
* L1 evaluation and reverse auctions
* MSE and Startup benefits
* Local content (Class I/II supplier) requirements
* Experience submitting bids with a DSC on e\-procurement portals.
* Excellent documentation skills and strong attention to detail.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word and PDF tools.
* Good written and spoken English and Hindi.
* Ability to manage multiple bids and meet tight deadlines.
* AI tools like Claude and Chatgpt for documentation

Preferred

* Experience bidding for defence, PSU or technology tenders (electronics, drones, IT or engineering equipment).
* Familiarity with the procurement portals and DPSU vendor registration.
* Basic understanding of technical specifications, enough to prepare compliance sheets.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* GEM Tender Works: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

c4ae720c.description:
**Company Description**
**👋🏼** 
**We're Nagarro.**
 We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18000\+ experts across 40 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non\-hierarchical. We're looking for great new colleagues. That's where you come in!
   

  

**Job Description**
**REQUIREMENTS:**
* Total Experience:7\.5\+ years
* Should be able to lead end\-to\-end Salesforce Health Cloud solution architecture and delivery for large, enterprise healthcare implementations.
* Deep expertise in Health Cloud features, including Patient/Member Profiles, Care Plans, Care Programs, Care Teams, Health Timelines, Assessments, Care Gaps, and Utilization Management. Strong leadership in translating complex healthcare business requirements into scalable Salesforce Health Cloud solutions.
* Should be able to drive architectural decisions covering Salesforce core, Health Cloud extensions, integrations, data models, and automation.
* Should have hands\-on leadership experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Triggers, Batch Apex, and Salesforce APIs.
* Should be able to define and govern integration architecture using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7\.
* Must have strong understanding of EHR/EMR integrations, payer/provider workflows, and patient/member lifecycle management.
* Should be able to lead all phases of the delivery lifecycle requirements, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.
* Provide technical governance, conduct design/code reviews, and manage architectural risks and technical debt.
* Should be able to lead and mentor multi\-shore Salesforce teams, including developers, admins, QA, and offshore delivery teams.
* Should have hands\-on experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as Copado, Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins.
* Should be able to collaborate closely with program managers to manage scope, timelines, risks, and delivery commitments.
* Should be able to drive innovation and continuous improvement, including PoCs, adoption of new Salesforce Health Cloud features, and platform enhancements.
* Should be able to participate in roadmap planning, release strategy, and long\-term platform evolution discussions.
* Must have strong experience working in Agile / Scaled Agile environments, supporting sprint planning and release management.
* Excellent communication, leadership, decision\-making, and stakeholder management skills.
* Mentoring the team members to meet the client's needs and holding them accountable for high standards of delivery.
* Being able to understand and relate technology integration scenarios and be able to apply these learnings in complex troubleshooting scenarios.


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Understanding the client’s business use cases and technical requirements and be able to convert them into technical design which elegantly meets the requirements.
* Mapping decisions with requirements and be able to translate the same to developers.
* Identifying different solutions and being able to narrow down the best option that meets the client’s requirements.
* Own overall Health Cloud technical strategy, ensuring scalability, security, and compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA/PHI).Showcasing a consulting mindset by acting as a solution provider rather than an order taker.
* Act as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders, architects, and senior leadership on Health Cloud capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve high\-level and low\-level technical designs, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
* Ensure adoption of Salesforce best practices, governor limit optimization, performance tuning, and code quality standards.
* Guide teams on Salesforce security model, data access, sharing rules, consent management, and compliance needs.
* Identifying project/service stakeholders at an early stage and working with them to ensure that the
* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and Salesforce technical teams.
* Collaborate with Salesforce Architects and Developers to design scalable, best\-practice solutions.
* Validate solution feasibility against Salesforce platform capabilities and project constraints.
* Prepare and maintain process flows, business process models, functional diagrams, and documentation.
* Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Act as a trusted advisor to users by explaining Salesforce capabilities and solution trade\-offs.
* Support user adoption through training materials, user guides, and release notes.
* Analyze existing Salesforce implementations and recommend process improvements and optimization opportunities.
* Defining guidelines and benchmarks for NFR considerations during project implementation
* Writing and reviewing design document explaining overall architecture, framework, and high\-level design of the application for the developers
* Reviewing architecture and design on various aspects like extensibility, scalability, security, design patterns, user experience, NFRs, etc., and ensure that all relevant best practices are followed.
* Developing and designing the overall solution for defined functional and non\-functional requirements; and defining technologies, patterns, and frameworks to materialize it
* Understanding and relating technology integration scenarios and applying these learnings in projects
* Resolving issues that are raised during code/review, through exhaustive systematic analysis of the root cause, and being able to justify the decision taken.
* Carrying out POCs to make sure that suggested design/technologies meet the requirements.


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

91157de4.title: AGM - Solution Delivery
91157de4.description:
Vodafone Idea Limited is an Aditya Birla Group and Vodafone Group partnership. It is India’s leading telecom service provider. The Company provides pan India Voice and Data services across 2G, 3G and 4G platform. With the large spectrum portfolio to support the growing demand for data and voice, the company is committed to deliver delightful customer experiences and contribute towards creating a truly ‘Digital India’ by enabling millions of citizens to connect and build a better tomorrow. The Company is developing infrastructure to introduce newer and smarter technologies, making both retail and enterprise customers future ready with innovative offerings, conveniently accessible through an ecosystem of digital channels as well as extensive on\-ground presence. The Company is listed on National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in India.
   

  

 We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At VIL, we know that diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages authenticity and fosters a sense of belonging. We strive for everyone to feel valued, connected and empowered to reach their potential and contribute their best.
   

  

 VIL's goal is to build and maintain a workforce that is diverse in experience and background but uniform in reflecting our Values of Passion, Boldness, Trust, Speed and Digital. Consequently, our recruiting efforts are directed towards attracting and retaining best and brightest talents. Our endeavour is to be First Choice for prospective employees.
   

  

 VIL ensures equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, colour, religion, creed, age, sex, sex stereotype, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy, veteran or military service status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 VIL is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversifying its workforce.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Lead the delivery, development, maintenance, and operational support of assigned BSS IT applications, ensuring reliable, scalable, and high\-quality technology solutions aligned with business and IT priorities. Drive end\-to\-end execution across Agile, Waterfall, and DevOps delivery models, with accountability for platform stability, service availability, production rollouts, and timely L2/L3 incident resolution. Collaborate with internal teams, partners, and vendors to manage risks, improve operational efficiency, and enable continuous technology modernisation.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Act as the technology and BSS domain SME for Telecom Billing and Bill Presentment application, ensuring solution feasibility and effective translation of business requirements into scalable technology outcomes.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of change requests, enhancements, and projects across Agile, Waterfall, and DevOps delivery models, ensuring adherence to agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business priorities.
* Review solution designs, product backlogs, low\-level designs, development approaches, testing strategies, and release plans to ensure alignment with system capabilities, enterprise architecture, cost objectives, and technology roadmaps.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, IT teams, partners, and vendors for requirements clarification, effort validation, delivery planning, issue resolution, and timely completion of project milestones.
* Drive stable 24x7 operations for business\-critical BSS platforms by monitoring availability, uptime, service performance, operational KPIs, business transaction trends, and technical success/failure patterns.
* Manage L2/L3 production support, incident resolution, problem management, root\-cause analysis, MTTR reduction, and SLA adherence for critical business services and platform operations.
* Ensure disciplined adherence to IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, release, deployment, post\-production validation, and service assurance governance.
* Identify and implement automation, proactive monitoring, alarm optimisation, process improvements, and technology modernisation initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, resiliency, and service reliability across the BSS portfolio.
* Ability to assess solution design, integration dependencies, non\-functional requirements, performance, availability, security, privacy, and operational resilience Application \& platforms.


**Competency**
**Functional Competencies:** 
 Strong understanding of telecom revenue management processes, including activation, provisioning, rating, charging, billing, collections, disputes, product catalogue, bill presentment, revenue assurance, and downstream financial workflows.
   

  

**Technical Competencies:** 
 Working knowledge of billing and charging platforms (Viz 6D and Amdocs Billing Suites), Aurion Pro Bill presentation and formats \[PS, PDF, XML], Understanding of Mobility and Fixed line data and voice products \[Viz, ILL IPLC, ITFS, cloud telephony etc], DevOps tools and technologies Jenkins/GitLab CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, Java technologies, Middleware’s \[IBM WebSphere, Wildfly etc.] , Databases \[Oracle, Single Store etc] and ITIL aligned operations in a distributed architecture setup.
   

  

**Technical/Professional Qualification**
* BE / B\-tech / MCA degree in IT/Technology
* Sound knowledge of Agile/DevOps frameworks/methodology and Tools
* Sound Knowledge of SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle)
* Industry certification like ITIL, PRINCE2, CSM, PMP
* Technical degree from Premium institute will be an added advantage


 Strong communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills. Competent in Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and Word.
   

  

**Vodafone Idea Limited** 
 (formerly Idea Cellular Limited)
   

  

 An Aditya Birla Group \& Vodafone partnership

6e92fd02.title: Cloud Support Engineer
6e92fd02.description:
**Cloud Support Engineer** 




**A high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India cloud support team** 




**Location:** 
 Remote (India)
 



**About the Company** 




 A high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India cloud support team and has partnered with Flexiple to bring on cloud support engineers. You will be one of the first cloud specialists on the ground, shaping how the company supports customers running its product across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 



**Role Overview** 




 As a Cloud Support Engineer, you will troubleshoot cloud infrastructure and deployment issues for customers, working closely with engineering to keep their environments stable and performant.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Cloud Troubleshooting \& Support** 



* Diagnose and resolve customer\-reported issues across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments
* Investigate deployment failures, connectivity issues, and performance bottlenecks
* Reproduce issues in test environments and document root causes clearly



**Reliability \& Product Partnership** 



* Partner with engineering to escalate and close out complex cloud issues
* Contribute to runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and internal cloud documentation
* Share recurring customer patterns with product to influence the roadmap



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



* 2 to 6 years in cloud support, DevOps support, or site reliability roles
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Comfort with Linux administration and basic scripting in Python or Bash
* Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote\-work setup



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Cloud certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP associate level or higher)
* Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product



**What We Offer** 



* A founding cloud\-support seat with a high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company
* Remote\-friendly, pan\-India hiring with long\-term placement
* Direct exposure to engineering leadership and product decisions
* One application considered for this and future matched roles



**Hiring Process** 




 HR Screening → Technical Assessment → Hiring Manager Round → Culture Fit
