37c740b5.title: AI/ML Solution Architect
37c740b5.description:
Education \& Assessment Platforms
   

  

**About Pratham International**
 Pratham International is a US 501(c)(3\) established to support learning innovations for children and youth in contexts across the globe. We enable the adaptation and spread of proven and scalable education solutions pioneered in India by Pratham Education Foundation to contexts across the global south through programming and technical assistance tailored to local realities. Today, Pratham innovations reach millions of children annually through partnerships across \~30 countries.
   

  

 Through the Pratham Shah PraDigi Innovation Centre (PraDigi), Pratham International also seeks to create technology innovations for low\-resource communities, and support models aimed at learning for school, work, and life for children and youth. We work on several cutting\-edge projects in the domain of Generative AI, Automatic Speech Recognition, and Natural Language Processing.
   

  

 The team's innovative technology products include the PadhAI: Reading Assessment App, which uses advanced speech recognition to evaluate children's reading fluency in 8 Indian languages and 6 global languages; Anytime Testing Machine (ATM), an AI\-enabled question generation and grading system that allows learners to be assessed on any topic, anytime; and a suite of AI\-powered chatbots designed for diverse learning contexts: from early childhood care, to youth employment readiness, and OCR\-based analysis tools that digitize and assess student work at scale.
   

  

 At Pratham International, we build for the long term. Whether it's ensuring products are truly accessible across rural India and the global south through languages, building datasets to ensure context and accuracy for products, or gathering feedback from the field. Backed by partners like Google.org, Anthropic, and the Gates Foundation, we are committed to building digital public goods that ensure every child is in school and learning well.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**About the work**
 We design and deliver AI systems that governments and large education programmes can actually run: curriculum\-aligned item generation, paper assembly, handwriting OCR, rubric grading, and teacher\-in\-the\-loop review. The work is already live as practice assessment in India and is being built as a national exam platform in Rwanda, with further country programmes behind it.
   

  

 We are hiring a Solution Architect who sits between discovery and delivery. You will turn messy workshop notes and ministry requirements into architecture a team can build, secure, cost, and operate — RAG and multi\-agent systems, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, and the cloud/LLMOps layer underneath.
   

  

**You will**
* Own solution design from first workshop to a delivery\-ready blueprint (services, data stores, trust boundaries, cost, ops).
* Architect LLM pipelines: generation, retrieval over curriculum knowledge graphs, standards/duplication/quality judges, constraint\-based paper assembly.
* Design human \+ AI workflows with audit, segregation of duties, cycle\-pinned config, and no student PII in model calls.
* Choose and govern models, prompts, eval gates, and fallbacks (including OCR: Azure primary, secondary fallback).
* Shape the Azure/AWS platform: identity, networking, LLMOps/MLOps, observability, and sovereign\-hosting constraints.
* Run client workshops, write POVs and architecture packs, and stay accountable until the system is in production.


**About the work**
 Pratham International programmes sit at the intersection of pedagogy, public systems, and production AI. The pattern is consistent across countries; the constraints change.
   

  

* **Anytime Testing Machine (ATM) — India, practice and feedback** 
 End\-to\-end assessment for real classroom conditions: generate curriculum\-aligned items, digitise handwritten answers (often photographed on a phone), grade against rubrics, and return feedback a teacher reviews before it reaches the learner. Built for high pupil–teacher ratios, mixed language (e.g. Hindi \+ English), and uneven connectivity. Pilots have already reached thousands of learners, including Second Chance (women returning for Grade 10\). Model quality is measured against expert golden sets, not vendor slides.
* **National assessment automation** 
 A government\-grade exam platform. Phase 1 is item authoring and print\-ready paper composition before the exam window. Phase 2 is script intake, OCR at national volume, AI\-assisted grading with human confirmation on the pilot, results export, and monitoring/evaluation reporting. Subjects span core and elective streams across the curriculum. Design rules that do not exist in a typical SaaS product: cycle\-pinned configuration, embargoed papers, hash\-chained audit trails, and integration with national student information and assessment management systems.
* **Curriculum knowledge graphs** 
 Structured retrieval corpora (concepts \+ worked examples) that ground generation and judging. This is the standing public\-knowledge exception in an otherwise closed exam system, and the seed of a broader education DPI conversation.
* **AI in TaRL and teacher support** 
 AI tools that help teachers group and teach by learning level, with an RCT\-shaped evidence bar. Same product family: human agency stays in the loop; the model is a capacity multiplier.
* **Country programmes and the three\-year direction** 
 Adapt the same engine to new ministries, languages, and exam rules (Kenya and other Global South programmes are in scope). The longer bet is a learning and credentialing engine that recognises competence beyond a single syllabus.


 This is not a chatbot brief. It is constrained generation, retrieval, judging, document AI, workflow, and public\-sector operations.
   

  

**Why this role exists**
 Most enterprise AI dies between the workshop and production. We need one person who owns that gap: someone who can sit with NESA, C4IR, Pratham pedagogy, and engineering in the same week, and leave behind a blueprint the delivery team can execute without inventing policy.
   

  

 The target profile is a practising AI/ML Solution Architect — not a pre\-sales slide owner, and not an infra\-only platform engineer. The person should have done all three of these:
   

  

* Designed GenAI / NLP solutions, PoCs, and client workshops, and can talk to research\-grade issues (eval, agent safety, prompt\-injection, model\-specific behaviour).
* Owned the AI platform: LLMOps, MLOps, DevSecOps, SRE habits, cloud migration, and FinOps.
* Taken messy discovery and turned it into Azure\-centred RAG and multi\-agent designs that a security team will accept.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Discovery → architecture**
* Lead solution workshops with programme, ministry, and engineering stakeholders.
* Convert half\-formed requirements into service cuts, data stores, sequence diagrams, decision gates, and open\-question lists with owners.
* Write architecture decision records. When the docs disagree (they will), force a decision instead of coding both.


**AI system design**
* Design LLM jobs as contracts: inputs, JSON schema, temperature, persist prompt hash / model / tokens / latency.
* Architect generation grounded in structured curriculum blueprints and knowledge\-graph retrieval, not "ask the model for a maths paper."
* Design LLM\-as\-judge banks (cognitive\-level, relevance, difficulty, language, fairness, standards, duplication, blueprint compliance) with thresholds, one\-repair rules, and golden\-dataset release gates.
* Design hybrid assembly: constraint solver first, model only on ties and layout exceptions.
* Design document AI: primary OCR provider, secondary fallback provider, confidence routing, de\-identification before any grading call.
* Specify eval: inter\-rater agreement, rubric\-band exact match, first\-pass item acceptance, cost per paper cycle.


**Platform, trust, cost**
* Own the reference architecture on the chosen cloud platform(s): identity, RBAC \+ segregation of duties, private networking, key management, object storage for scans, vector index, data warehouse for monitoring/evaluation reporting.
* Draw trust boundaries. Student PII never crosses the model gateway. Prompts are curriculum \+ knowledge\-graph \+ blueprint content only.
* Put FinOps on the design: token budgets, OCR cost caps, degradation behaviour when a cap is hit, model routing.
* Specify LLMOps/MLOps: prompt/version registry, eval regression as a release gate, observability, rollback.
* Design for sovereign hosting and exam\-cycle operations (embargo, watermarking, append\-only audit, cycle\-pinned configuration).
* Delivery and thought leadership
* Stay with the build through the first production cycle. Architecture that cannot be implemented is unfinished work.
* Produce POVs, sequence packs, and workshop artefacts that can be reused in the next country.
* Mentor tech leads on where the model should stop and the workflow should start.


**Success in the first two quarters**
**First 30 days — Orient**
* Complete architecture walkthroughs of every live/in\-flight system with the current engineering leads; document current state (services, data stores, trust boundaries) as\-is, not as\-designed
* Meet every active stakeholder group once: engineering, programme/domain leads, and any external partner or government\-side counterpart
* Inventory all open technical decisions and disagreements in existing specs; log each with current owner (if any) and status
* Identify the single highest\-risk unresolved design question and flag it upward


**Day 60 — Diagnose**
* Produce a current\-state architecture diagram covering every major pipeline: data flow, model/LLM touchpoints, storage, and identity/access boundaries
* Assign an owner and target resolution date to every open contradiction identified in month 1
* Draft a v1 reference architecture for one representative end\-to\-end workflow: service breakdown, data stores, identity/access model, model gateway placement, and a first\-pass cost estimate


**Day 90 — Commit**
* v1 reference architecture is reviewed and accepted by engineering and relevant stakeholders (not just self\-signed)
* Can walk any core pipeline end\-to\-end from memory and name every data store, every quality/eval gate, and every trust boundary in it
* At least one architecture decision record is published for a previously\-contested design question, with the decision forced rather than left open
* A first cost model exists for the reference architecture, with at least one identified lever for reducing spend if usage scales


**Day 120 — Harden**
* Core pipeline components (generation, retrieval, judging/eval, or equivalent stages for this domain) have documented contracts: defined inputs/outputs, schema, and logged metadata (model, version, cost, latency)
* An evaluation harness exists for at least one component, with a defined pass/fail threshold
* A release gate exists that can block a bad prompt, model, or config change from reaching production


**Day 150 — Extend**
* The next major system phase or capability is specified to the same rigor as the first: trust boundaries, failure modes, fallback behavior, and cost caps documented before build starts
* FinOps guardrails are in place for at least one production workload: budget ceilings, degradation behavior when a cap is hit, and a routing or fallback strategy Day 180 — Generalize
* A reusable design pattern or adaptation pack exists, separating what is fixed in the architecture from what varies by deployment context (e.g. language, hosting environment, external\-system integration, content/domain rules)
* At least one engineering or technical lead has been mentored on where model\-based logic should stop and deterministic/workflow logic should take over
* A second production\-readiness review (security, cost, or operations) has been passed on a system this person designed or substantially redesigned


**Qualifications and Experience**
**Must have**
* 8\+ years building software or data/AI systems, with recent experience as a Solution Architect, AI/ML Architect, or Principal/Staff Engineer with end\-to\-end architecture ownership.
* Shipped at least one production AI/ML system — RAG, multi\-agent, LLM\-as\-judge, or a comparable classical ML/NLP pipeline at scale — that passed a real security, cost, and operations review, not just a pilot or a slide deck.
* Can produce a delivery\-ready architecture blueprint: services, data stores, IAM, failure modes, evaluation strategy, and cost model — detailed enough that engineering isn't guessing at intent.
* Deep cloud experience on Azure and/or AWS: comfortable defending a landing\-zone design, private\-endpoint architecture, and a real monthly compute/inference/OCR spend.
* Fluent in Python, with hands\-on experience in both classical ML (model training, evaluation, feature pipelines) and how LLM APIs, embeddings, and vector search actually behave under production load.
* Comfortable running a room with non\-engineers — domain specialists, IT stakeholders, monitoring/evaluation teams — and translating fluently in both directions.
* Strong written English; this role's output is documentation that functions as a binding technical contract.


**Strongly preferred**
* Azure AI (AI Foundry / OpenAI / Document Intelligence), plus one of AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker) or GCP (Vertex, BigQuery).
* LLMOps / MLOps: prompt \+ model versioning, MLflow or equivalent, eval harnesses, CI that can block a bad prompt.
* Document AI / OCR at volume; handwriting and low\-quality scans, not only clean PDFs.
* RAG over structured knowledge (graphs, ToS, textbooks) and hybrid search, not only naive chunking.
* Education, assessment, public sector, or other high\-audit domains (health, finance, identity).
* Certifications: Azure Data Scientist / Azure Solutions Architect; AWS SAA, ML Specialty, or Data Analytics Specialty.
* Experience with agent security: tool\-use limits, DLP on egress, prompt\-injection evaluation that is model\-specific.
* FinOps discipline. You have killed a design because it would not survive the token bill.


**Nice to have**
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool integration for agentic workflows.
* Constraint solvers or exam\-blueprint / item\-bank systems for automated test assembly.
* Multilingual generation and feedback, including code\-mixed language pairs (e.g. Hindi–English, Spanish–English, or similar).
* Experience standing up golden/eval datasets with subject\-matter experts.
* Prior work with government data systems, data\-sharing agreements, or in\-country/sovereign hosting requirements.


**What this role is not**
* Not a research\-only post. Publications help; shipping is the job.
* Not a pure platform/SRE hire. Infra is part of the design, not the whole design.
* Not a prompt engineer who hands off "the architecture" to someone else.
* Not a people manager of a large team on day one — you influence through artefacts and reviews.


**How we will assess you**
 We value transparency and respect your time. Our hiring process is designed to evaluate both hands\-on technical depth and architectural judgment through practical, real\-world tasks.
   

  

**Stage 1: Application \& Knockout Screening**
* Submit your CV alongside key screening responses
* Artefact — send two of: architecture note, eval design, runbook, ADR. Slides without decisions do not count.


**Stage 2: Initial Conversation (30 mins)**
* An introductory screen covering your background, project context and baseline alignment.
* An opportunity for you to ask questions about our technical roadmap, partner ecosystem, and vision.


**Stage 3: Practical Take\-Home Written Assessment (2–3 hours)**
* Design exercise on a constrained generation \+ judge \+ human\-review pipeline (we will use a sanitised exam\-authoring brief). We want trust boundaries, eval, and cost, not a model\-name dump.


**Stage 4: Deep\-Dive Technical \& System Architecture Walkthrough**
* Walkthrough of a system you shipped: what failed in review, what you changed, what it costs to run.


**Stage 5: Final Stakeholder \& Vision Alignment**
* Final conversation with key technical leadership and program stakeholders.


**Employment Details**
* Function: Solutions / Architecture
* Reports to: Head of Technology / CTO
* Expected Start Date: Immediate
* Location: India (remote\-first; travel to client workshops as needed)
* Experience: 8–13 years (strong 6–8 considered if you have shipped production GenAI)
* Engagement: Full\-time
* Remuneration: Based on candidate's experience and skillset
* Flexibility to work across timezones: Our team spans Latin America to Southeast Asia. Early mornings or late evenings can be a regular part of the rhythm


**Why join us?**
**Impact at Scale:** 
 Your work will directly support the learning journeys of millions of children. With programs active in 31 countries, you will help build Digital Public Goods that bridge the gap for the millions of children across the Global South who still struggle with foundational literacy
   

  

**Innovation at the intersection of Education and Technology:** 
 Lead the charge in redefining learning and learning processes through technology. You will contribute to the design and development of cutting\-edge learning tools and AI\-driven initiatives, ensuring EdTech isn't just a buzzword, but a scalable solution for global equity.
   

  

**A Culture of Growth and Evidence:** 
 At Pratham, we value rigorous testing and continuous learning. You will have the autonomy to experiment with the latest SOTA models, supported by a 5\-year strategic roadmap and funding from partners like the Gates Foundation and Anthropic.
   

  

**High\-Calibre, Mission\-Driven Team:** 
 You will work alongside a global team of experts from institutions like MIT, Harvard, and INSEAD. Our alumni have gone on to lead successful startups and international policy shifts, all while remaining dedicated to the goal of "Every Child in School and Learning Well."
   

  

**Inclusive and Collaborative Environment:** 
 Join a diverse team that spans Asia, Africa, and Latin America. We value innovative thinking and local expertise, ensuring that the technology we build is deeply rooted in the realities of the communities we serve.
   

  

*Pratham International is an equal opportunity employer and encourages all qualified people from diverse backgrounds to apply for positions within our organisation, regardless of race, gender, disability or any other status.*

872cdd40.title: Delivery Head – Oracle Cloud
872cdd40.description:
* **Location:** Gurugram
* **Openings:** 1


  
**Role Overview**


At Kovaion, the Delivery Head is a key pillar of project delivery, customer success, and long\-term account growth. The role is responsible for ensuring successful execution of Oracle Cloud engagements while building strong, trusted relationships with customers and identifying opportunities to expand the partnership.


This is a strategic, customer\-facing leadership role that combines delivery management, stakeholder management, project governance, team leadership, and account growth. The Delivery Head will work closely with customers and internal teams to ensure that projects are delivered on time, within scope and quality expectations, while continuously identifying opportunities to enhance customer value.


The role involves approximately 80% delivery leadership and 20% business development/account growth.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Delivery \& Project Leadership**


* Provide overall leadership and governance for multiple Oracle Cloud projects and customer accounts.


* Take end\-to\-end ownership of project delivery, ensuring commitments related to scope, timelines, quality, and customer expectations are met.


* Work closely with project teams to plan, execute, and monitor project activities and deliverables.


* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, resource plans, and delivery roadmaps.


* Monitor project progress, identify risks and dependencies, and take timely corrective actions.


* Ensure effective allocation and utilization of project resources across engagements.


* Establish appropriate governance mechanisms, including regular project reviews, status reporting, and escalation management.


* Ensure project documentation, deliverables, action items, and governance artifacts are maintained appropriately.


* Facilitate project, steering committee, and customer meetings and ensure effective follow\-through on agreed actions.


* Proactively identify delivery risks and challenges and drive them to resolution.


* Ensure consistent adherence to organizational delivery processes, quality standards, and project management practices.


**Customer \& Stakeholder Management**


* Act as a trusted advisor and strategic point of contact for customers throughout the engagement lifecycle.


* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and decision\-makers.


* Understand customer business objectives, priorities, challenges, and expectations and align delivery accordingly.


* Ensure customers derive maximum value from Oracle Cloud solutions and services.


* Proactively identify customer concerns, delivery challenges, and potential risks to customer satisfaction.


* Establish regular customer connects to assess engagement health and address concerns before they escalate.


* Manage escalations effectively and coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution.


* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, achievements, and key decisions clearly to customer stakeholders.


* Build long\-term relationships that strengthen customer confidence and retention.


**Team \& Resource Management**


* Lead and mentor project managers, functional consultants, technical consultants, and delivery teams.


* Ensure the right skills and resources are available at the right time across projects.


* Drive accountability for project deliverables and individual responsibilities.


* Identify resource constraints and proactively plan for current and future requirements.


* Foster collaboration between functional, technical, delivery, and support teams.


* Support capability development and continuous improvement within delivery teams.


**Account Growth \& Business Development**


* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within existing Oracle Cloud accounts.


* Understand evolving customer requirements and identify opportunities for additional services and solutions.


* Partner with sales and solution teams to develop proposals, RFP responses, estimates, and solution approaches.


* Support account planning and contribute to expanding the customer relationship.


* Identify opportunities to transition project relationships into long\-term strategic partnerships.


* Maintain a strong understanding of the customer’s technology landscape and future roadmap to identify relevant service opportunities.


**Delivery Governance \& Continuous Improvement**


* Track key delivery and customer\-health indicators and provide management reporting.


* Conduct periodic project and account reviews to identify improvement areas.


* Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, project governance, resource utilization, and customer experience.


* Establish and monitor KPIs related to delivery performance, customer satisfaction, project profitability, and account growth.


* Proactively address potential delivery and customer\-retention risks.


* Promote best practices across projects and customer engagements.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**


* 8–12 years of experience working in the Oracle Cloud ecosystem.


* Proven experience managing multiple Oracle Cloud projects and/or customer accounts.


* Strong experience in project/program delivery and customer stakeholder management.


* Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects involving multiple teams and stakeholders.


* Strong understanding of project management methodologies such as Agile and Waterfall.

**Description**
 The Amazon Flex program uses independent drivers—called delivery partners—to deliver to our customers. Through the Amazon Flex app, drivers sign up for the program, schedule pickup times, are guided during routes with the navigation system, and more.
   

  

 As the Amazon Flex Program Manager, you will be responsible for the strategy and initiatives aimed at improving the quality and efficiency of the deliveries carried out by the program. To achieve your goals, you'll work with diverse areas of the organization, including technology, operations, and marketing. A successful program manager will work to enhance the experience of hundreds of drivers, both within operations and when carrying out delivery routes, through data analysis, identifying obstacles and problem spots, and implementing effective and well\-defined standards. These improvements must be balanced with business needs and take into account key operational metrics. Effective stakeholder management skills are essential to balance these competing priorities and delivering effective solutions for our customers and drivers.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Support long\-term strategic planning to improve quality and efficiency.
   

  

* Work closely with the areas of finance, marketing, capacity management, operations, engineering, and program management on process improvement and launch initiatives.
* Develop, implement, and oversee reports, ensuring clear visibility of project milestones and performance.
* Effectively influence stakeholders through collaboration and effective prioritization.
* Be responsible for key performance indicators and work closely with stakeholders to understand everyday opportunities and challenges in order to implement short and long\-term solutions.
* Monitor the execution of projects and ensure that the delivery is at the appropriate quality level and in compliance with the expected deadline.
* Navigate and resolve ambiguities by applying creative problem solving skills.
* Identify and mitigate risks, preventing them from becoming larger problems.


**About The Team**
 Amazon Flex’s Advocacy Operations (AO) team is seeking highly skilled and motivated operations manager to assist in the tactical operations management and execution of Amazon Flex related projects and deliverables worldwide. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an operations Manager, you will be responsible for defining and executing the operations roadmap and requirements for the operations function in Advocacy Operations. Throughout this process the operations manager will drive continuous innovation and improvements to deliver fast, easy, and rich functionality, and help deliver on the best\-in\-class customer experience. The successful candidate will manage operations across worldwide Flex\-enabled marketplaces (US, CA, UK, IN, JP, AU, SG, MX, BR), leading high\-performing managers to execute various tasks including DP account management, bulk communications, compliance workflows, and programmatic support. You will play a pivotal role in implementing strategic automation initiatives while identifying opportunities to build long\-term solutions that eliminate manual work without negatively impacting the DP experience.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Knowledge of SQL


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross\-functional teams

 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.

With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing agentic and RAG\-based workflows.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language\-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre\-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI technologies.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their language\-related requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG\-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG\-based solutions.
* Collaborating and working with Government, Research and Public sector departments


**What We Need To See**
* B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In\-depth understanding of state\-of\-the\-art language models, including but not limited to GPT\-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine\-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

 Who we are:
   

  

 At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our clients to co\-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30\+ countries, we build for boundless impact, touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at .
   

  

**Summary**
 UST is looking for a
 **Senior Cloud Software Engineer** 
 with expertise in cloud platform engineering, cloud\-native application development, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation\-first operations, and AI\-powered CloudOps. The role will be responsible for designing, developing, governing, and optimizing enterprise\-scale AWS and Azure environments while driving intelligent automation, self\-healing operations, and AI\-enabled cloud solutions.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Senior Cloud Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in building cloud\-native platforms, automation frameworks, AI\-enabled operational tooling, and enterprise\-scale infrastructure solutions. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-efficient cloud services while enabling platform standardization and engineering excellence.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
 Cloud Software Development
   

  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain cloud\-native services and internal platforms using Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
* Build secure, scalable RESTful and event\-driven APIs leveraging Azure and AWS cloud services.
* Develop reusable libraries, frameworks, and shared services to standardize cloud consumption and accelerate delivery.
* Apply clean architecture, SOLID principles, and enterprise design patterns to create resilient and maintainable solutions.
* Design solutions with scalability, observability, security, resilience, and cost optimization as key requirements.
* Develop automation tooling and cloud services supporting large\-scale Azure and AWS environments.


 AI, Generative AI \& Agentic Engineering
   

  

* Design and implement AI\-enabled cloud services, intelligent automation solutions, and operational tooling.
* Build and integrate Generative AI solutions using RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, and context management.
* Design and orchestrate AI agents and multi\-agent workflows for cloud operations, remediation, and engineering activities.
* Integrate AI agents with enterprise systems using MCP, tool\-calling, and function\-calling patterns.
* Implement guardrails, evaluation frameworks, observability, token controls, and Responsible AI practices.
* Ensure compliance with AI governance, privacy requirements, prompt injection protection, and data security standards.

* Collaborate cross\-functionally with teams like Amplitude's Product, Engineering, Platform Support and Technical Success Manager to streamline internal processes and improve data management experience for our customers

* 5\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing data or analytics role — implementation, solutions/sales engineering, analytics engineering, or data consulting.

* Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.


**We care about the well\-being of our team:** 
 We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well\-being of our Ampliteers.
   

  

**Some Of Our Benefit Programs Include**

* 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually
* Flexible time off, p aid holidays, and more
* Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more
* Excellent Parental benefits including : 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back\-up Child Care support

9fe443d6.title: Principal Program Manager
9fe443d6.description:
**Description**
 Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go\-to partner for the world’s most forward\-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting\-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI\-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI\-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.
   

  

**Overview**
 Synaptics is looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our Global Operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in semiconductor design and manufacturing processes, coupled with exceptional program management skills. As the ASIC Program Manager, you will oversee the entire product lifecycle from concept through production, working closely with cross\-functional teams including design, verification, validation, and manufacturing to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality ASICs. The successful candidate will play a key project leadership role, acting as the primary owner of SOC program execution on the project planning scheduling, inter\-team coordination, status tracking and reporting. Sr. Director, Program Management.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Competencies**
 Job Duties
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end program management of engineering programs from idea to mass production including planning, scoping, design, development, and change management
* Lead and coordinate all aspects of ASIC development programs from requirements gathering through to final product release, including design, verification, validation, and production rampup
* Work closely with internal engineering teams (ASIC design, firmware, validation, etc.), external partners, and vendors to manage deliverables and ensure alignment on project goals and schedules
* Support the teams in issue resolution and risk mitigation through well balanced and efficient processes leveraging tools and automation
* Actively support sustainable, effective cross\-functional communication at multiple levels in the organization
* Analyze technical issues and lead the team in generating creative mitigation options and solutions
* Act as the primary point of contact between engineering, product management, and senior leadership, providing regular status updates on program progress, issues, and risk management
* Monitor and manage the program budget, ensuring projects are delivered within financial constraints
* Manage relationships with operation team and external ASIC vendors, ensuring that they meet technical and delivery requirements
* Ensure proper documentation of program processes, designs, and decisions throughout the ASIC development lifecycle
* Drive continuous improvement of all processes, methodologies, and systems


 Competencies
   

  

* Well organized with strong attention to data and detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
* Ability to ask difficult but important questions and drive discussion to find answers
* Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations
* Developing talent, ability to inspire and excite team
* Highly structured planner with a strong discipline towards pragmatic and efficient processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in agile execution and facilitating multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to synthesize and report complex matters simply for senior and executive management to grasp quickly
* Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work within a diverse team


**Qualifications (Requirements)**
* Bachelor's (Master’s preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent
* A deep understanding of ASIC design, verification, and manufacturing processes is essential.
* 15\+ years of experience in Program Management, including 5\+ years of expertise in engineering program management Experience in rigorous life\-cycle management including capturing requirements, decomposition, architecture, design, unit testing and integration testing among others
* Proven expertise in planning tools and methodologies (Jira, MS Project / SCRUM, waterfall)
* Hands\-on technical experience preferred
* No travel required


*Belief in Diversity
   

  

 Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.*

4a131d6d.title: Edtech Program Manager
4a131d6d.description:
**Company Description** 
 Skillofy\_AI is a next\-generation edtech company focused on empowering learners with technical and non\-technical skills needed to succeed in a rapidly evolving digital world. The company delivers hands\-on, industry\-driven programs for students, working professionals, and organizations through live, mentor\-led sessions and practical, project\-based learning. Skillofy\_AI offers a wide range of tech programs in AI, system design, full stack development, and engineering, alongside non\-tech programs in program management, product management, and professional skills. In addition to education, Skillofy\_AI builds AI\-powered solutions for businesses and supports career transformation through structured learning paths, mentorship, and real\-world exposure. Its mission is to bridge the gap between learning and real\-world application and become a global hub for talent development and innovation powered by AI.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Edtech Program Manager at Skillofy\_AI is a full\-time, remote role responsible for end\-to\-end ownership of learning programs across tech and non\-tech domains. In this role, the Program Manager designs and structures curricula, coordinates live mentor\-led sessions, and ensures that program content is aligned with industry needs and learner outcomes. Day\-to\-day tasks include managing program timelines, collaborating with instructors and subject\-matter experts, tracking learner progress, and implementing feedback to continuously improve course quality. The Program Manager also oversees learner communication, supports onboarding and engagement, and partners with operations, marketing, and product teams to drive enrollment, retention, and successful career transitions for participants. This role requires strong program execution, data\-driven decision making, and a learner\-centric mindset.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Program and project management skills, including planning, scheduling, stakeholder coordination, and risk management.
* Experience in curriculum design, instructional planning, and learning experience optimization for online or blended programs.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage mentors, instructors, and diverse learner groups.
* Data analysis and reporting abilities to track learner outcomes, program performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with edtech platforms, LMS tools, and remote collaboration technologies.
* Understanding of both tech and non\-tech career paths; exposure to AI, software development, or product/program management is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, Engineering, Management, or a related field; advanced certifications in program or project management are beneficial.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote setting, with a focus on accountability, organization, and results.

 Looking to jump\-start your career?
 



  





 We understand how important the first few years of your career are, which create the foundation of your entire professional journey. At Indegene, we promise you a differentiated career experience. You will not only work at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology but also will be mentored by some of the most brilliant minds in the industry. We are offering a global fast\-track career where you can grow along with Indegene’s high\-speed growth.
 



  





 We are purpose\-driven. We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision\-making, and industrious in the way we work.
 



  





 If this excites you, then apply below.
 



  





 About Indegene
 



  





 We are a technology\-led healthcare solutions provider driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to become future\-ready. At Indegene, you will work at the intersection of healthcare, technology and innovation, while gaining exposure to global clients, experienced industry leaders and high\-impact transformation programs.
 



 We value entrepreneurship, collaboration, empathy and continuous learning. If this excites you, apply below.
 



  





 Role Description
 



  





 We are seeking an AM/Manager – Digital Strategy and Solutions to lead
 **strategic solutioning, solution packaging, executive storytelling and digital transformation initiatives** 
 for life sciences clients.
 



 The role will work across business, technology, operations and commercial teams to convert client needs into
 **clear, scalable and commercially viable solutions** 
 . The individual will support proposals, RFPs, client workshops, capability development, pilots and strategic transformation programs.
 



 The role requires the ability to move from an early\-stage idea to a
 **well\-structured solution, compelling client narrative and implementation roadmap** 
 .
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Strategy and Solutioning
 



  




* Lead the design and execution of strategic digital transformation initiatives.
* Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions and operating models.
* **Structure ambiguous client requirements into clear use cases, workflows, capabilities and roadmaps.**
* **Recommend suitable solution approaches based on client maturity, existing technology and transformation readiness.**
* Identify operational gaps and define opportunities for process improvement, automation and AI adoption.



  





 Solution Packaging and Commercialization
 



  




* Develop solution frameworks for proposals, RFPs and client engagements.
* **Package capabilities, platforms, accelerators and delivery experience into repeatable offerings.**
* **Define the solution scope, value proposition, differentiators, outcomes and delivery approach.**
* **Work with pricing, delivery and finance teams to ensure solutions are commercially practical.**
* **Create reusable assets such as playbooks, assessment frameworks, use\-case libraries and reference architectures.**



  





 Storytelling and Client Engagement
 



  




* **Develop executive\-ready narratives for client pitches, proposals, analyst briefings and capability presentations.**
* **Convert complex business and technology concepts into clear and easy\-to\-understand stories.**
* **Partner with design teams to create simple, visual and impactful presentations.**
* Support client workshops, presentation preparation and leadership discussions.
* **Prepare talking points, scripts and responses for strategic client meetings and oral presentations.**



  





 Proposals and GTM Support
 



  




* Lead or support RFPs, RFIs, proactive proposals and strategic pursuits.

* **Ensure that proposals communicate one connected solution story rather than a list of disconnected capabilities.**
* **Support the development of pilots, demonstrations, case studies and sales\-enablement content.**
* Capture client and market feedback to improve future solution offerings.



  





 AI and Emerging Solutions
 



  




* Stay current on developments in AI, GenAI, automation, analytics and digital platforms.

* **Consider data readiness, governance, evaluation, integration and human oversight while designing AI solutions.**
* Balance innovation with feasibility, compliance and business value.



  





 Delivery and Team Leadership
 



  




* Manage transformation initiatives and ensure timely delivery and measurable outcomes.
* Define and track KPIs aligned to client and organizational goals.
* Ensure quality, governance and compliance across solution delivery.
* Build and manage cross\-functional teams across strategy, operations and technology.
* Mentor team members and support capability development.

* 4–12 years of experience in digital strategy, consulting, solutioning, pre\-sales or transformation roles.

* **Proven ability to convert business requirements into structured solutions and client\-ready narratives.**

* **Understanding of life sciences commercial areas such as CRM, marketing automation, content operations, customer data and digital analytics.**

* Experience managing cross\-functional and global teams.

d608ff30.title: Senior Business Solutions Engineer, BizTech(LegalTech)
d608ff30.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

 L9 \- Senior Business Solutions Engineer, Legal Tech
   

  

 Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
 The Legal Technology team, within the BizTech organization, leads the mission to deliver innovative technology, empowering our legal function to utilize technology productively, driving connection, and scale support. This role sits within BizTech and partners directly with Airbnb's global Legal organization to accelerate the deployment of AI\-powered tools, implementation of legal systems \& integrations, and workflow automation across the CLO org.
   

  

**The Difference You Will Make**
 We're looking for a world\-class Senior Business Systems Engineer to help redefine how Legal operates. You'll deliver fast, practical solutions using internal tools and agentic AI — owning system and tool changes end\-to\-end, from design through support.
   

  

 You'll spot what's slowing teams down, champion best practices, and safeguard data integrity across our platforms — all while staying ahead of how AI is reshaping the way we work.
   

  

 This isn't conventional IT or Legal Ops. You'll be embedded directly within our Legal teams, solving real challenges in real time. As a key driver of our Legal Tech strategy, you'll lead the deployment of AI agents, legal application implementations, and automation that scales our global legal infrastructure.
   

  

 If you're energized by fast\-paced problem\-solving and want to shape the future of legal technology with AI — this is the role for you.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Embedded Deployment \& Enablement
   

  

* Partner directly with practice group leads, paralegals, and in\-house counsel to identify high\-value workflow automation and AI integration opportunities.
* Act as the technical DRI for Legal AI tools — from intake through deployment — owning the full lifecycle development within your assigned legal function.
* Build, test, and deploy Legal AI workflows, multi\-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, and AI copilots powered by Claude Enterprise. Building MCPs would be add on
* Run discovery workshops and translate business requirements into engineering\-ready specifications for internal engineering teams.


 Governance \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Navigate internal governance processes (PLADIS, Security, Privacy) on behalf of Legal stakeholders — managing intake, review, and approvals.
* Maintain the Legal Tech project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are tracked, prioritized, and communicated effectively to leadership.
* Build trusted relationships with Deputy General Counsels, Legal Ops leads, and cross\-functional partners in BizTech, Security, and Engineering.


 AI Enablement
   

  

* Design and deliver Claude Enterprise training sessions for Legal teams — covering prompting, workflow integration, and responsible AI use.
* Create adoption playbooks, user guides, and enablement materials tailored to Legal personas (lawyers, paralegals, legal ops).
* Track usage metrics and adoption KPIs; report to Legal Technology and CLO leadership on impact.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 8\+ years of professional experience in Legal Technology, or Enterprise SaaS implementation — preferably in a tech company or law firm technology function.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience demonstrably using AI in workflows and to support customers.
* Proven track record of architecting and building AI\-powered applications including multi\-agent workflows, retrieval systems, and LLM integrations
* Proven track record in forward\-deployed, embedded, or client\-centric technical positions.
* Experience researching and implementing custom applications from the Marketplace from research, to design and implementation
* Advanced degree (e.g., MS/MBA) in Business, Computer Science, or related fields preferred.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing custom business solutions and integrations using enterprise platforms.
* Skilled at stakeholder engagement and cross\-functional collaboration in large global organizations.
* Adept at leading complex projects, simplifying technical concepts, and promoting operational excellence.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in critiquing technical designs and leading workshops, and engaging with senior leadership.
* Identifies opportunities for product and process improvements and can lead and implement said improvements, obtaining necessary buy\-in from stakeholders and leadership..


**Reasonable Accommodations:** 
 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
   

  

**A Note on Recruiting Scams:** 
 Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work\-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

c383f5bd.title: Predictive Science - AI Engineering & Prompt Architecture Lead - Vice President
c383f5bd.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Take a lead role in acquiring, managing and retaining meaningful relationships that deliver outstanding experience to our customers. In this role, you will balance your focus on business results by offering options and finding solutions to help our customers with issues.
As a Vice President – AI Engineering \& Prompt Architecture Lead in Predictive Science, you will own the technical vision and delivery for a team of prompt engineers and AI/ML model developers building intelligent document processing and data extraction solutions in the KYC/AML domain.


**Job Responsibilities:**

Architect agentic, multi\-step AI workflows chaining classification extraction cross\-validation* exception routing with human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints.
* Debug and remediate complex prompt failures (context\-window overflow, instruction drift in long chains, RAG retrieval poisoning, output/format instability).
* Design prompt/model evaluation frameworks measuring accuracy plus consistency, robustness, latency, cost\-per\-call, and hallucination rate.
* Operationalize prompt lifecycle management as production code: versioning, CI/CD prompt tests, A/B experiments, rollback, and audited change history.
* Guide model selection and optimization (prompting vs fine\-tuning vs custom training) balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and data sensitivity.
* Design RAG architectures for financial documents: chunking, embeddings, vector store design, re\-ranking, and context injection.
* Oversee fine\-tuning/training workflows: dataset curation, annotation quality, training configurations, and generalization across document variants.
* Build and maintain evaluation infrastructure: benchmark/golden datasets, regression suites, and automated scoring to catch regressions pre\-production.
* Define confidence calibration and escalation logic so systems estimate uncertainty and route low\-confidence outputs to human reviewers with the right context.
* Partner with governance/model risk and data engineering: produce validator\-ready documentation (explainability/auditability) and ensure robust, refreshed data/annotation/eval pipelines; drive AI\-native development practices to improve velocity.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:**


* 10\+ years in NLP/AI/ML or computational linguistics, including 3\+ years leading technical teams with direct reports.
* Hands\-on LLM internals expertise: tokenization impacts, attention limits, context window management, and temperature/sampling trade\-offs.
* Proven prompt architecture design/debugging: multi\-turn chains, few\-/many\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, self\-consistency, and constitutional AI.
* Strong RAG system design experience: embeddings trade\-offs (e.g., ada/BGE/Cohere), chunking for semi\-structured docs, hybrid retrieval (dense\+sparse), and re\-ranking.
* Fine\-tuning experience: LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF/DPO, dataset curation, and evaluating tuned vs prompted performance.
* Python \+ ML engineering proficiency: PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex (or equivalents), vector DBs (Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector), and API development.
* AI evaluation systems experience beyond F1: faithfulness, answer relevance, RAG context precision/recall, automated eval pipelines, and LLM\-as\-judge.
* Deep understanding of LLM failure modes: hallucinations, sycophancy, long\-context instruction degradation, prompt\-format sensitivity, and catastrophic forgetting.
* Structured output enforcement in production: JSON mode, function calling, constrained decoding, output parsers, and schema validation.
* Build\-vs\-buy/model selection track record: benchmarking foundation models (GPT\-4/Claude/Llama/Mistral) against task requirements.
* Leadership under ambiguity: pragmatic trade\-offs, rapid iteration as practices evolve, and strong communication with compliance, risk, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills:**
* Domain expertise in KYC/AML or financial document processing: entity extraction from registries, beneficial ownership structures, sanctions screening logic, adverse media classification.
* Experience designing autonomous AI agents: tool\-use patterns, planning/reasoning loops, memory architectures, and safety guardrails for regulated environments.
* Knowledge of AI security/adversarial robustness: prompt injection defense, jailbreak detection, data poisoning awareness, and output monitoring for sensitive financial data.
* Experience with model distillation to produce smaller, faster models for cost\-effective deployment.
* Familiarity with AI observability/monitoring: tracking prompt/model performance, drift detection, alerting, and health dashboards.
* Experience with multi\-modal AI combining OCR, layout understanding, and LLM\-based extraction for complex documents.
* Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in CS/NLP/ML or equivalent depth via publications, open\-source, or production system design and Passion for talent development: growing engineers from junior prompt writers into senior AI system designers via structured mentorship.

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

b899d8e1.title: SAP FICO Architect
b899d8e1.description:
**Job Description – SAP Finance \& Controlling (FICO) Application Track Lead** 




 Company Overview
 



 Tech Orbit Solutions is a fast\-growing IT consulting organization delivering SAP\-led digital transformation programs across multiple industries. The company focuses on high\-quality consulting, strong delivery governance, and long\-term client partnerships. We are building deep SAP capabilities across GROW with SAP, RISE with SAP, and AMS models, with a strong emphasis on ownership, rigor, and solution excellence.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Solution Architect to lead the Sales and Logistics track. This role is responsible for end\-to\-end solution architecture, delivery assurance, competency and capability building for the SD track, and active involvement in pre\-sales. The Solution Architect will act as the design authority across SAP S/4HANA programs and will play a key role in scaling consulting maturity within the organization.
 



 Key Responsibilities – Finance Solution Architecture \& Roadmapping
 


* Design SAP S/4HANA Finance architecture covering FI, CO, Asset Accounting, Treasury, and Group Reporting.
* Drive adoption of advanced finance capabilities such as SAP ICMR, Advanced Financial Closing (AFC), Margin Analysis, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Planning, and Management of Bank Communication (MBC).
* Align finance transformation journeys with GROW with SAP and RISE with SAP initiatives.
* Leverage SAP BTP for finance extensions, side\-by\-side applications, event\-driven scenarios, and integrations.



 Cross\-Module \& Technical Integration
 


* Architect integrated finance processes across SD, MM, PP, PS, EWM, and external systems.
* Enable real\-time and batch integration using SLT, APIs, and SAP BTP integration services.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, GAAP, and country\-specific localization requirements.



 Solution Delivery \& Governance
 


* Lead SAP FICO delivery across greenfield, brownfield, and rollout programs.
* Own design governance, quality assurance, and architectural sign\-offs.
* Oversee testing cycles, cutover planning, deployment, and post\-go\-live stabilization.



 Finance Transformation \& Business Outcomes
 


* Drive finance transformation focused on faster financial close, improved working capital, and real\-time reporting.
* Define and govern finance KPIs such as Days to Close, Manual Journal Entry Ratio, Intercompany Reconciliation Cycle Time, and Reporting Timeliness.
* Ensure SAP designs directly support controllership, audit readiness, and executive decision\-making.



 GROW, RISE \& RUN (AMS) Ownership
 


* Define fit\-to\-standard and clean\-core principles for cloud\-led SAP Finance implementations.
* Ensure solutions are transition\-ready from project delivery to Hypercare and AMS.
* Build finance AMS playbooks covering close operations, compliance controls, and continuous improvement.



 Pre\-Sales \& Client Advisory
 


* Act as Finance Solution Architect during RFP and proposal stages.
* Lead solution discovery workshops and finance roadmap discussions.
* Support estimations, commercials, PoCs, and executive presentations.



 Practice, Capability \& People Development
 


* Build and scale the SAP Finance practice, including offerings, accelerators, and reference architectures.
* Mentor and coach consultants across experience levels.
* Support hiring, upskilling, certification, and succession planning.



 Key Skills \& Expertise
 


* 15–16 relevant years SAP FICO experience, including min. 5\+ years in architecture/lead roles.
* S/4HANA, ICMR, AFC, SAC Planning, and Group Reporting hands\-on delivery.
* Central Finance, Greenfield, or Brownfield migration experience preferred.
* Strong expertise in GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, CO\-OM, CO\-PC, and Margin Analysis.
* Hands\-on experience with Financial Closing Cockpit, Embedded Analytics, Fiori, and SAC.
* Experience with Central Finance, migrations, and global rollouts.



 Education \& Certifications
 


* CA, CPA, MBA (Finance), or master’s degree in accounting / finance / IT.
* SAP S/4HANA Finance and Management Accounting certifications.
* Group Reporting, SAC, and ICMR certifications preferred.



  





 Certifications – Desired
 


* SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA for Financial Accounting
* SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA for Management Accounting
* SAP Certified Application Specialist – SAP S/4HANA for Group Reporting
* SAP Certified Integration Associate – SAP Analytics Cloud
* SAP Certified – Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR)



 Good to Have Certifications
 



 \- SAP Activate HANA Cloud
 



 \- SAP RISE with SAP / GROW with SAP badges
 



  





 Mindset \& Cultural Fit
 


* Strong ownership mindset with accountability for outcomes.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-growing consulting environment.
* Commitment to rigor, integrity, and client success.

**About Us:**


We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH\+.

Learn more about Inclusion \& Diversity at PVH **here**.

  

  

**Job Description**

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Senior Front\-End Architect will lead the design and implementation of modern, headless e\-commerce storefronts using Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC). This role centers on leveraging the Composable Storefront (PWA Kit) and Managed Runtime to deliver secure, scalable, ADA\-compliant digital commerce experiences. The architect will define technical vision, guide development teams, and ensure execution of best\-in\-class front\-end engineering practices.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES/ACCOUNTABILITIES OF THE JOB:**


* Architectural leadership and technical direction


* Lead design and deployment of Composable Storefronts using PWA Kit and Managed Runtime


* Mentor developers and enforce best practices


* Define API integration strategies with SFCC and third\-party services


* Optimize for performance, scalability, SEO, and accessibility


* Collaborate with product, business, and UX stakeholders


* Assess emerging technologies for roadmap enhancement


* Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues


* Manage dependency hygiene, vulnerability audits, and semantic versioning

**INTERNAL \& EXTERNAL CONTACTS:**


* **Internal:** Works closely with business and technology teams, including engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.


* **External:** Engages with technology vendors, consultants, and industry partners to stay updated on best practices and emerging trends.


**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Direct: None


* Indirect: Provide leadership \& guidance to outsourced vendor resources


**BUDGETARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Maintain the environment to minimize budget overflows

**DECISION MAKING:**


* Leads decision\-making on data product development and prioritization in collaboration with stakeholders.


* Recommends technology investments and improvements to enhance data product capabilities.


**RESOURCEFULNESS/CREATIVITY:**


* Ensures technology solutions align with business needs, emphasizing usability, scalability, and cost\-effectiveness.


* Requires strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex business and technical challenges.


**ENVIRONMENT:** This role requires the ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities effectively. Domestic and international travel may be required.

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:**

**Experience:**


* 8\+ years front\-end development, 3\+ in technical leadership


* Expert\-level Salesforce Commerce Cloud (B2C) experience


* Deep experience with PWA Kit (Composable Storefront) and Managed Runtime


* Expertise in React, Node.js, and modern JavaScript


* Strong knowledge of web vulnerabilities and mitigation practices


* Expert dependency management (npm/Yarn)


* Strong API\-first and event\-driven integration experience


* DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud deployment experience


* Proven accessibility and performance engineering expertise


* Git experience and team mentoring experience

  


 

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree required, in any relevant STEM, or technology/engineering disciplines

  



 **Skills:**


* SFCC Developer or Architect certifications


* Agile development experience

* Requires strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex business and technical challenges.


**ENVIRONMENT:** This role requires the ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities effectively. Domestic and international travel may be required.

  


**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:**

**Experience:**


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience.


* 2\+ Headless storefront implementation experience preferably with full cycle implementation of SFCC Composable storefront/PWA Kit.


* Expert\-level React knowledge, including Hooks, Context API, SSR (Server\-Side Rendering), and state management.


* Strong grasp of SFCC Core Concepts: Mastery of SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API) and OCAPI is essential.


* Code Quality Specialist: Proven experience resolving issues reported by Code quality platforms, including security vulnerabilities, code smells, and maintainability debt.


* Modern Frontend Stack: Expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, ES6\+, and Chakra UI (or similar CSS\-in\-JS libraries).


* Integration Expertise: Experience integrating with OMS, Payment Gateways (via SLAS), and third\-party services in a decoupled environment.


* Performance Mindset: Strong understanding of Core Web Vitals, Service Workers, and caching strategies within Managed Runtime.


* Agile/Scrum: Experience delivering scalable UI within fast\-paced Agile environments.

  


 

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree required, in any relevant business, liberal arts, STEM, or technology/engineering disciplines

  



 **Skills:**


* SFCC PWA Kit and Composable Storefront.


* Experience with 3rd Party tools like Optimizely, Content stack


* Experience with Mocha for automated testing.


* Knowledge of traditional SFRA (to assist in migration/logic extraction).


* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.


* Languages: JavaScript (ES6\+), TypeScript, JSON, SCSS.


* SFCC: PWA Kit, Composable Storefront, SCAPI, OCAPI, Business Manager, SLAS.


* Frontend: React (Expert), TypeScript, Node.js, CSS\-in\-JS (Chakra UI).


* Quality/DevOps: SonarQube, Git, Jira, Postman, Managed Runtime (MRT).


* Legacy Systems: SFRA, ISML (understanding required for migration logic).


* Note: **Apex\-only or traditional SFRA\-only profiles are NOT suitable;** this role requires deep React and Headless\-specific SFCC experience. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to refactor legacy logic into modern React patterns. Candidates must have recent, hands\-on experience with **PWA Kit implementation**.

Are you passionate about helping organizations modernize and migrate business\-critical databases to the cloud?

 At SoftwareOne, we help organizations modernize their data platforms and accelerate cloud adoption through expert consulting and delivery services. We are looking for a Cloud Database Migration DBA to support database transformation initiatives across AWS, Azure, and on\-premises environments, helping customers migrate, optimize, and modernize their database workloads.

Working closely with Cloud Architects, Infrastructure Engineers, Application Teams, Security Specialists, and customer stakeholders, you will ensure successful migration outcomes while minimizing risk, downtime, and business disruption.
 




  
 




**Key responsibilities:** 




* Delivering database migration and modernization projects across on\-premises, AWS, Azure, and managed database platforms.

 Strong experience working with enterprise database platforms such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL.
 





 Practical experience delivering cloud database migration projects involving AWS and/or Azure database services.
 





 Strong understanding of database migration methodologies including assessment, schema conversion, remediation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover execution.
 





 Knowledge of Change Data Capture (CDC), replication technologies, high availability, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, and downtime minimization strategies.
 





 Strong SQL skills, database performance troubleshooting expertise, and experience optimizing database workloads.
 





 Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and customer\-facing consulting skills.
