a855030c.title: Account Strategist, Google Customer Solutions
a855030c.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Gurugram, Haryana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with stakeholder management, business, sales industry or customer engagement.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Knowledge of the local market with excellent investigative skills.
* Knowledge of traditional and online marketing strategy and tactics, and products across all digital advertising.
* Ability to lead and manage multiple projects with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to think about issues and develop recommendations and action plans.

**About the job**
-----------------


Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI\-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.



In this role, you will work with the advertisers to shape their business growth and strengthen relationships. You will drive product adoption and business growth. You will anticipate how decisions are made at C\-Level and you will explore and uncover the business needs of customers, and understand how the range of product offerings can grow their business. You will set the goal and strategy for how their advertising can reach users.


Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small\- and medium\-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage a portfolio of customers alongside account managers to deliver against goals, while prioritizing and delivering a quality sales experience to customers.
* Establish credibility with executives and serve as a trusted consultant to optimize and expand their advertising investment by understanding business drivers, identifying opportunities for growth, managing risks and creating multi\-quarter plans for sustainable business growth.
* Drive business growth, partnerships, business planning and strategy, review, and education for customers.
* Coach peers in the organization to create skill lift that drives customer growth and contributes to team success.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enable customer growth.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

414c7a28.title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
414c7a28.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
   

  

**The Role**
 AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base.
   

  

 We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. The reviews on here paint many stories of successes, failures, excitement and disappointment. Every person has their own story. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Sr Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
   

  

 In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
   

  

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.


 What You'll Need
   

  

**Must\-Have**
* 10\+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


 Regional travel up to 35%.

6b46671e.title: Customer Engineer II, Platform, Google Cloud
6b46671e.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on\-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience driving the entire sales cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long\-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
* Experience working with AI, building Agentic systems and AI based solutions.


**About the job** 
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Platform Customer Engineer, you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical\-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross\-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in\-depth workshops.
* Architect cross\-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post\-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross\-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. Manufacturing Master Data (BoM, Recipe / Routings, Work Centre etc.), Production Planning, Demand Management, Sales \& Operations Planning, Material Requirements Planning, Manufacturing execution, Capacity planning \& execution, Movement of Raw Materials \& Goods, Cost Management

* Experience in driving Business process workshops, Fit / GAP analysis and post go live activities

* Design, Build \& Optimize End to End SAP Manufacturing Processes for customers enterprise
* Leading large scale transformation projects’ Manufacturing Workstream leveraging experience including PP object data migration experience in S/4HANA
* Conduct systematic client workshops to drive \& derive Key Design Decisions with Industry best practice recommendations
* As a Solution Architect, lead the engagement efforts at different stages from problem definition to diagnosis to solution design, development \& deployment in large S/4 HANA transformation programs
* Create detailed design and architecture, and process artifacts, implement the solution and the deployment plan
* Connect with senior client business and IT stakeholders, demonstrating thought leadership in domain, process, and technology
* Develop \& nurture strong client relationships to gain the trusted strategic advisors

 SAP PP / Manufacturing with Pharma \& Process Industry experience. e0ad00e2.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India
e0ad00e2.description:
**Description**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

 As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
   

  

 You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web \& mobile applications with data store technologies.
   

  

 AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
   

  

 Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
   

  

 Our team also puts a high value on work\-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well\-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
   

  

 As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. **The Opportunity:**
**What Your Impact Will Be**

This role will play a pivotal part in enabling global supply chain transformation by leveraging Blue Yonder’s advanced planning capabilities to optimize supply planning, inventory positioning, and production strategies. The candidate must be willing to work on site 4 days a week in Hyderabad, during US EST time zone.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Lead and own the end\-to\-end architecture and design of Blue Yonder ESP (Enterprise Supply Planning) solutions.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs that align with industry best practices and Blue Yonder's functional framework.
* Define planning models, network design, constraints, and heuristics aligned to business supply strategies.
* Expertise in interpreting solver results ensuring optimized planning quality based on constraints.


**Configuration \& Development**
* Configure and develop components within Blue Yonder ESP, including supply planning, inventory balancing, pegging, and constraint\-based planning logic.
* Customize ESP engines to align with business supply network models, demand signals, and production capacities.
* Create and manage planning parameters, supply chain hierarchies, and master data elements.


**Implementation \& Configuration**
* Configure ESP modules including supply planning, constrained planning, and inventory optimization.
* Guide integration of ESP with up/downstream systems (Demand Planning, ERP, MRP, MES, Google Datalake).
* Oversee data modeling, master data configuration, and rule\-based planning logic.


**Technical Leadership \& Governance**
* Provide leadership and guidance to implementation teams and technical consultants.
* Review and approve functional and technical design documents.
* Ensure adherence to Blue Yonder standards and change management protocols.


**Business Collaboration \& Change Enablement**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders across supply chain, manufacturing, and IT to gather requirements and align solution outcomes.
* Conduct design workshops, walkthroughs, and training sessions to ensure knowledge transfer and user adoption.
* Act as the primary point of contact for solution design decisions and issue resolution.


**Continuous Improvement \& Support**
* Identify and propose enhancements for planning performance, configuration, or data integration.
* Support hypercare and transition to steady\-state planning operations.
* Evaluate emerging Blue Yonder capabilities and industry trends to evolve the planning landscape.
* Contribute to production support and documenting processes and facilitating enablement sessions to empower stakeholders with the necessary skills and knowledge to utilize BY ESP solutions effectively.
* Education Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience 10\+ years of experience in supply chain planning, with at least 5\+ years in Blue Yonder ESP architecture or implementation.
* Technical Skills Hands\-on expertise in configuring, designing and deploying Blue Yonder ESP modules (Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, S\&OP, Manufacturing Planning) solutions and managing Control\-M with extensive experience of MAP solver and ability to understand and interpret solver output ensuring optimal planning results. Strong understanding of planning algorithms (constrained/unconstrained), pegging, and network optimization. Scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) skill is a must. Experience with integration to ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, or Infor. Familiarity with data integration tools (e.g., SAP PI, MuleSoft, Informatica) and batch/scheduled data feeds.
* Leadership Skills Excellent communication, leadership, and client\-facing skills.
* Problem\-Solving Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
* Cultural Awareness Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and highly dynamic environment and manage teams across different time zones. Must be multi\-tasker and able to prioritize and deliver assignments with the highest quality under pressure with short deadlines.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Blue Yonder certification in ESP or SCPO suite is highly desirable.
* Experience in scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) is a significant advantage especially OIL scripts.
* Experience in deploying complex BOM, Load building planning, dynamic deployment functionality is highly preferred.
* Experience in SPARQ solver is a plus.
* Experience in large\-scale global supply chain transformation programs.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Knowledge of other Blue Yonder modules (Demand Planning, Sequencing, Control Tower) is a plus.
* Knowledge of Anaplan (planning) models is a plus.

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
   

  

**How We Work**
 We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
   

  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.

**Job Description**
**Ciklum** 
 is looking for a
 **Senior Solution Architect** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.
   

  

 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

 As a Senior Solution Architect, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define the target architecture, integration patterns and reusable components across the conversational AI, API and data layers
* Design API contracts and middleware that decouple the virtual assistant from backend systems
* Produce solution designs, architecture diagrams and technical decision records for client review and sign\-off
* Agree access, integration approach and non\-functional requirements with client architects and system owners
* Run technical feasibility spikes and assess API readiness, dependencies and delivery risks
* Set the security and authentication approach, including identity, access control, audit logging and PII handling
* Keep track of the client's wider programme landscape to avoid duplication and design conflicts


**Requirements**
* API and middleware design: REST, canonical JSON contracts, payload transformation (JSON, XML, SQL), versioning, retries, rate limiting and standardised error handling
* Cloud architecture, ideally AWS serverless (API Gateway, Lambda, Secrets Manager, DynamoDB), with CI/CD awareness. Equivalent GCP or Azure depth is acceptable
* Security and identity: OAuth2, OIDC, JWT, service accounts, role\-based access control and GDPR\-aware data handling
* Data integration: warehouse and analytics platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks, including secure API access
* Applied LLM experience: prompt design, extraction of structured data from free text, confidence scoring and guardrails
* Integration with CRM and ticketing platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle Service Cloud, Jira Service Management or ServiceNow
* Clear written and verbal communication, including producing design documentation that passes enterprise review
* 8 or more years in software or solution architecture, including 3 or more years as a solution or integration architect on enterprise programmes
* Consulting or client\-facing experience in large, matrixed organisations


**Desirable**
* Voice AI or contact centre as a service (CCaaS) experience
* Multi\-agent or supervisor orchestration patterns
* Experience modernising or wrapping legacy APIs
* Work in regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare or education
* Relevant cloud or platform certifications (for example AWS Solutions Architect Professional)


**Personal Skills**
* Pragmatic: knows when to wrap a legacy system and when to wait for its replacement
* Proactive in unblocking access and dependencies with system owners, rather than designing around them
* Comfortable making and defending design decisions while several workstreams are moving at once


**What’s in it for you?**
* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
   

  

**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

 As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
   

  

 You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web \& mobile applications with data store technologies.
   

  

 AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
   

  

 Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
   

  

 Our team also puts a high value on work\-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well\-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
   

  

 As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

* 5\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 10\+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience


**Preferred Qualifications**

**Education:**

47084d58.description:
**Company Description**
 Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.
   

  

 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of  what we do:
   

  

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner
* 3300\+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK \& Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


 We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an Oracle Cloud ERP Functional Support Consultant (L2\), you will be responsible for providing first and second line support across the Oracle ERP suite. You will act as the initial point of contact for user queries and system issues, ensuring effective triage, resolution where possible, and appropriate escalation to L2/L3 teams.
   

  

 This is a process\-driven, customer\-focused role requiring strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively within an ITIL\-aligned support environment.
   

  

 You must be willing to work flexible hours on rotation including cover until 23:00 UK Time/ 04:30 IST (shift allowance payable).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* You will deliver day\-to\-day operational support activities across one or more Oracle ERP modules (Financials, Procurement, Projects, HCM and other ERP areas), working as part of a global managed services team.
* Your responsibilities will include triaging incoming incidents and service requests, assessing their priority and business impact, and ensuring they are correctly categorised, logged, and assigned within the ITSM tool. You will take ownership of tickets through their lifecycle, monitoring progress, proactively following up with resolver groups, and ensuring timely resolution within agreed SLAs.
* As part of your role, you will resolve standard L1 \& L2 queries directly. This includes responding to “how do I” questions from end users, providing guidance on system processes, and supporting users in navigating Oracle Cloud ERP functionality. You will perform routine system administration activities such as user setup, password resets, role provisioning, and basic access management in accordance with defined security and governance procedures.
* You will engage with customers through agreed communication channels, providing regular and clear updates on ticket status and ensuring a high standard of customer service at all times.
* Where issues cannot be resolved at L1 or L2, you will ensure they are escalated to L2/L3 support teams with sufficient detail, including replication steps, logs, and impact analysis, to enable efficient resolution.
* You will contribute to knowledge management by documenting recurring issues, known errors, and standard operating procedures, helping to build a robust and reusable knowledge base.
* Additionally, you will support service improvement initiatives by identifying recurring incidents or trends and raising these with senior team members to enable root cause analysis and problem management.
* You will also assist in supporting Oracle Cloud quarterly release cycles by carrying out defined testing activities, logging defects, and supporting validation of fixes under guidance.


**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications \& Experience**
* Experience working in an application support or service desk role (2 to 3 years preferred)
* Exposure to Oracle ERP Cloud (Financials including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, PPM and related modules)
* Good understanding of basic ERP processes and business workflows
* Experience using ITSM tools for incident and request management
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts such as incident management, service requests, and SLAs
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills with strong attention to detail
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work in a shift\-based model and collaborate across global teams


**Desirable Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle Cloud ERP modules (Finance, Projects, Procurement, etc.)
* Experience with user/security administration (role assignment, access control)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud navigation, reporting tools (e.g. OTBI), or workflows
* Exposure to testing processes or release management activities
* Awareness of integrations or interfaces within ERP ecosystems


**Key Behaviours \& Attributes**
* Customer\-first mindset with a focus on responsiveness and service quality
* Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tickets concurrently
* Process\-driven approach with adherence to defined support procedures
* Willingness to learn and develop functional expertise across Oracle ERP modules
* Ability to work collaboratively within onshore/offshore delivery teams


**Additional Information**
 Why Version 1?
   

  

 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.
   

  

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression \& mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance \& Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Version 1 Pension with a 5% employee\-matched contribution, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more.
* 24 days holiday allowance plus Public Holidays, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards \& quarterly Star Awards.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


 And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.
   

  

 Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer
   

  

 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.
   

  

 We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact the recruiter at Kunal.gouri@Version1\.com . We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

+ Daily stand\-ups
+ Retrospectives

* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications

**Description**
 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Engagement Manager to lead and deliver complex, multi\-workstream cloud transformation programs for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end delivery lifecycle of large and complex customer engagements, shaping cloud strategies, driving business outcomes, and acting as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is an experienced program leader with deep IT consulting expertise, a proven track record in delivering complex technical programs across enterprise customers, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with limited guidance. You thrive in a fast\-paced, growth environment, insist on incredibly high standards, and are passionate about mentoring others and scaling delivery best practices across teams.
   

  

 You will lead matrixed teams of AWS consultants, partners, and customer resources across multiple workstreams simultaneously. You are expected to drive delivery excellence, maximize engagement value, manage risks proactively, and serve as a force multiplier for your peers and the broader organization. You will actively contribute to pre\-sales, build deep customer trust, and leverage AI/GenAI to drive delivery innovation.
   

  

 In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30\-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Engagement Management Delivery Practice Manager.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own and lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex, multi\-workstream cloud transformation programs, ensuring business outcomes are achieved within schedule, scope, and financial constraints.
* Shape and validate cloud delivery strategies for complex engagements, applying frameworks such as the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well\-Architected Framework (WAF), and Engagement Delivery Framework (EDF).
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, driving alignment, and building deep trusted relationships.
* Proactively identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues; develop and execute mitigation plans; redirect distressed programs to delight customers.
* Maximize engagement value by negotiating conditions of acceptance, managing scope changes, and amending contractual terms within project constraints.
* Drive delivery excellence across engagements by defining and sharing EM best practices, creating reusable mechanisms, and establishing operational excellence.
* Actively mentor and develop team members; perform Technical Promotion Assessments (TPAs) and coach Engagement Managers to raise the bar.
* Participate in pre\-sales activities, contributing to proposals, scoping, and business development for complex services engagements.
* Leverage Agentic AI and GenAI to optimize delivery processes, improve team productivity, and drive innovative customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional AWS teams including Delivery Consultants, Account Executives, Cloud Architects, and Partner teams to solution and deliver cloud programs.


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7\+ years of leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements experience
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 7\+ years of project/program management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with and presenting to C\-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
* PMP, Prince2, PgMP, SAFe or SCRUM/Agile certification
* 9\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Partner delivery experience — enabling and managing delivery through third\-party partners

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all\-remote R\&D PMO team, you will own complex, end\-to\-end programs that are central to our AI\-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high\-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next\-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. * Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
* Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry\-leading DevSecOps standards

* Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs

* Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
* Partner with customer success and cross\-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
* Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation

* Track record of success in fast\-paced, dynamic environments with evolving technical requirements and market opportunities
* Strong facilitation and influence skills, with ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups while building trust through transparency and delivery excellence
* Expertise in high\-level stakeholder management, including masterful communication with Executive Boards and enterprise Customers
* Collaborative leadership style aligned with GitLab's values, including respect, openness to feedback, and commitment to team success
* Proven track record of redefining organizational operations and serving as an escalation point to resolve highly complex, enterprise\-level challenges
* Welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with consulting, enterprise technology, or technical leadership experience who have owned outcomes and delivered transformational initiatives
* Ability to act as a visionary leader, shaping R\&D direction and fostering technical excellence across the organization


**About the team:** 
 The Technical Program Management team sits within GitLab's R\&D Program Management Office and drives product, engineering, data, and security initiatives across our AI\-powered DevSecOps platform. You will join our growing, distributed team of Technical Program Managers currently spanning North America and Europe. We own the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, cross\-functional programs including AI platform capabilities, enterprise customer initiatives, and strategic technology transformations. * Drive program execution to deliver high quality ASIC solutions
* Drive internal process improvements across multiple teams and functions
* Work with the software, hardware, architecture teams to understand requirements and constraints


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* BS degree in Computer Science, Computer / Electrical Engineering or other technical field
* 10\+ years of experience in ASIC development

* Experience in managing ASIC design flow (architecture, micro\-architecture, RTL, Synthesis, functional verification, physical layout etc.)
* Experience in pre\-silicon testing with Emulation, FPGA and post\-silicon validation

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
   

  

 You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind\-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
   

  

**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
 Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
   

  

 Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep\-dive education and design exercises to create world\-class solutions built on AWS.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI\-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one\-to\-few and one\-to\-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer\-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support


 A day in the life
   

  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities

 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

**Who We Are**
 Colgate\-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
   

  

 Join Colgate\-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
   

  

 Role Overview The Planning Solution Architect is the technical and functional visionary for the global supply chain planning landscape. This role is responsible for designing a seamless, end\-to\-end planning architecture that integrates Demand, Supply, Inventory, and S\&OP processes. You will lead the strategic transition from legacy SAP APO environments to modern platforms like Kinaxis Maestro, ensuring that the organization achieves "Concurrent Planning" capabilities and real\-time visibility.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architectural Strategy: Design the target\-state architecture for global planning, defining the co\-existence or migration strategy between SAP APO, SAP IBP, and Kinaxis.
* End\-to\-End Planning Integration: Ensure seamless data and process flow between Demand Planning (DP), Supply Network Planning (SNP), and Production Planning/Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS) within the planning hub.
* Concurrent Planning Excellence: Configure Kinaxis to enable instant "what\-if" scenario analysis, ensuring that a change in demand is immediately reflected across the entire supply network.
* Algorithm \& Solver Optimization: Lead the selection and configuration of planning engines, including Heuristics, Optimizers (Linear Programming), and Statistical Forecasting models.
* S\&OP Transformation: Architect the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process to align financial targets with operational capabilities, facilitating executive\-level decision\-making.
* Data Orchestration: Define the Master Data strategy (Material, Location, Resource, BOM, and Routing) required to sustain high\-fidelity planning models across multiple tools.


 Domain Expertise \& Planning Principles
   

  

* Demand Management: Mastery of statistical forecasting, demand sensing, and collaborative forecasting.
* Supply \& Capacity Planning: Deep understanding of Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP), constrained vs. unconstrained supply plans, and multi\-level pegging.
* Inventory Optimization (IO): Experience in Multi\-Echelon Inventory Optimization (MEIO) to balance service levels against working capital.
* Response \& Resupply: Designing logic for prioritized demand fulfillment and automated supply re\-balancing during disruptions.


 Technical Proficiency
   

  

* Kinaxis Maestro (RapidResponse): Expert\-level knowledge of Authoring (Resources, Attributes, Workbooks), Task Flows, and Integration .
* SAP IBP: Hands\-on experience with IBP Demand, IBP Supply \& Response, and IBP Inventory modules, including configuration of Planning Areas and Key Figures.
* SAP APO: Deep legacy knowledge of DP and SNP; ability to extract business logic from APO to migrate to modern cloud platforms.
* Integration Technologies: Proficiency in integrating planning hubs with ERP backbones (e.g., SAP S/4HANA or ECC) using SAP CPI\-DS, SDI, or flat\-file interfaces.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

acc57c7b.title: Technology Solution Engineer
acc57c7b.description:
**Role Overview**
 The Technology Solution Engineer works with business and technology stakeholders to shape technical solutions, then builds them. This is a deliberately broad, hands\-on role that combines consultative solution design with real delivery across the enterprise technology platforms.
   

  

 At this level, the Technology Solution Engineer owns solutions end to end. The role runs requirement workshops directly with business stakeholders, authors the design, makes independent technical decisions, and leads the build through to operational handover. Work spans the full platform estate rather than a single technology, and includes reviewing the work of others and mentoring less experienced engineers.
   

  

 The platforms in scope include cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services, integration, automation, APIs, containers, and web hosting. Platforms are run both as internal products and as managed services, so the role carries accountability for how solutions run as well as how they are built.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Consulting and Design**
* Engage business functions and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, constraints, and the problem behind the request.
* Facilitate requirement and design workshops, and translate outcomes into clear technical solution designs.
* Produce options analyses with honest trade\-offs across cost, risk, delivery time, supportability, and strategic fit.
* Author solution designs, architecture decision records, interface definitions, and non\-functional requirements.


**Cross\-Platform Solution Delivery**
* Design and build solutions spanning cloud infrastructure, integration, APIs, automation, containers, and web hosting.
* Provision and configure platform services using Terraform, Ansible, and the approved Infrastructure as Code toolchain.
* Develop supporting automation and tooling in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or another appropriate language.
* Lead technical delivery of solutions involving multiple platforms and multiple contributing teams.


**Service Transition and Operational Ownership**
* Ensure solutions meet operational readiness criteria before production release, including monitoring, alerting, runbooks, backup, and recovery.
* Instrument solutions for observability using Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Cribl, or Observe.
* Own investigation and resolution of complex issues, root\-cause analysis, and preventive corrective actions.


**Security, Compliance, and Risk**
* Design and build to enterprise security standards, applying identity and access patterns based on Entra ID, Okta, OAuth2, and least privilege.
* Manage secrets and certificates through HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, and cloud\-native key services.
* Identify and articulate technical risk, technical debt, and exceptions, with practical remediation proposals.


**Technical Craft and Engineering Practices**
* Write clean, tested, peer\-reviewed code and configuration, managed in version control with trunk\-based practices.
* Review the work of other engineers and raise the standard of design and implementation across the team.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate design, development, testing, and documentation, applying appropriate review and technical judgement.


**Collaboration and Ways of Working**
* Work within an agile team with a shared backlog, defined customers, and service\-level objectives.
* Act as a credible technical partner to business stakeholders, explaining trade\-offs in plain language.
* Coordinate across platform, cloud, integration, web, security, architecture, and operations teams.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through pairing, review, and structured feedback.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Demonstrated capability in solution engineering, platform engineering, or technical delivery
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud, with practical exposure to a second.
* Proven ability to own a solution end to end, from requirements through design, build, and operational handover.
* Practical Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform, and configuration management with Ansible.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or Java.
* Working knowledge across several of: containers and Kubernetes, integration and APIs, web hosting, networking, and identity.
* Demonstrated ability to run workshops and engage business stakeholders directly.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, including presenting designs to technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Preferred**
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small technical workstreams.
* Experience with OpenShift, Backstage or another developer portal, and GitOps tooling.
* Experience with integration or API platforms such as MuleSoft, Kafka, Solace, or Kong.
* Experience with web and application server technologies such as IIS, Tomcat, Apache, or Nginx.
* Experience delivering within a validated, GxP, or otherwise regulated environment, including awareness of data\-protection obligations such as GDPR.
* Certifications such as AWS or Azure professional or expert level, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, ITIL, or an agile qualification.
* A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline.


**Core Competencies**
* Consultative mindset with genuine interest in the business problem
* Strong technical judgement and architectural awareness
* Breadth across technologies combined with useful depth in several
* Clear communication and stakeholder credibility
* Bias toward reuse, standardisation, and simplification
* Ownership and accountability from design through to operation
* Willingness to mentor and raise the standard around them


**Measures of Success**
* Solutions delivered to agreed scope, quality, cost, and timeline
* Increased reuse of approved patterns and platform capabilities, and reduced bespoke build
* Reduced defects, rework, and post\-implementation incidents
* Improved availability and supportability of delivered solutions
* Stakeholder satisfaction and repeat demand from business functions
* Reduced security findings and audit exceptions in delivered solutions
* Demonstrable growth in the engineers mentored

 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you will be the first point of contact for our clients, ensuring their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You will proactively identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, focusing on first\-line support for standard and low\-complexity incidents and service requests. Your aim? To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.
   

  

 Every day, you will monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identifying problems and errors before or as they occur. You will dive deep into first\-line incidents assigned to you, pinpointing the root causes, and providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to our clients when they need it most. Maintenance activities, such as patching and configuration changes, will be part of your routine, ensuring the smooth operation of client systems.
   

  

 You will work across two or more technology domains, such as Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, or Collaboration. Your day may include updating existing knowledge articles or creating new ones, seeking opportunities for work optimization, and supporting project work as needed. Additionally, you will contribute to disaster recovery functions and tests, ensuring our clients' DATA is safe and sound.
   

  

 Shift changes are made seamless with your careful handovers, ensuring service continuity. You will report and escalate incidents when necessary and strive for efficient, comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests. With each interaction, you will aim to provide a positive client experience, placing their needs at the forefront of all you do.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Entry\-level experience with troubleshooting and support in security, network, DATA centre, systems, or storage within a medium to large ICT organization.
* Basic knowledge of management agents, redundancy concepts, and ITIL processes.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day\-to\-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
* Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
* Good understanding of using ITSM tools.
* Skill in planning activities and projects in advance and adapting to changing circumstances.
* A client\-centric approach, understanding their requirements and ensuring a positive experience throughout their journey.
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening techniques and refraining from interrupting.
* A positive outlook at work, even in pressurized environments.
* Willingness to work hard and put in longer hours when necessary.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT or Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).


**Workplace type:**
 On\-site Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
   

  

 Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
   

  

 responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
   

  

 unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
   

  

 application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
   

  

 confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
   

  

 than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
   

  

 established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
   

  

 year in R\&D.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
   

  

**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
 NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an
