0e9832e2.title: Director, Integrated Modeling Solutions
0e9832e2.description:
**Director, Integrated Modeling Solutions**


PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.




Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

**A PURPOSE DRIVEN COMPANY – 150 YEARS**

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1\.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.




At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high\-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.




Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.




**What you will do:**


Based in India, the Director, Integrated Modeling Solutions will lead the team responsible for the architecture, design, development, testing, governance, and delivery of Prudential's strategic PyVal and Eureka! modeling platforms. This role combines deep financial or actuarial modeling expertise with modern software engineering, people leadership, and disciplined execution to advance an integrated global modeling ecosystem supporting valuation, forecasting, capital management, asset liability management, reinsurance analysis, and strategic decision\-making.

**What you can expect:**
------------------------

* Set the technical direction and actionable roadmap for assigned PyVal and Eureka! capabilities, and lead the architecture, design, development, testing, and controlled deployment of scalable Python\-based modeling solutions.
* Translate global priorities into a sequenced portfolio of model development, enhancement, and remediation work, managing scope, capacity, dependencies, risks, releases, and delivery commitments across concurrent initiatives.
* Maintain rigorous model governance and controls across model logic, assumptions, data lineage, documentation, testing, access, release management, validation, and production support.
* Lead, coach, and build a high\-performing India\-based modeling team, strengthening capability across actuarial and financial modeling, Python engineering, insurance products, governance, and stakeholder management.
* Serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders across Finance, Actuarial, Investments, Treasury, Risk, Technology, and business teams, clearly communicating model insights, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

**What you will bring:**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Fellowship credential from the Society of Actuaries, Institute and Faculty of Actuaries, Institute of Actuaries of India, or an equivalent recognized actuarial body.
* Ten or more years of relevant experience in actuarial modeling, financial modeling, quantitative risk, insurance finance, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated people leadership and experience leading complex model development, transformation, or platform modernization initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
* Advanced Python expertise, strong knowledge of modern software development practices for controlled financial or actuarial models, and strong executive communication and decision\-making skills.

**What will set you apart?**


* Deep experience in life insurance, annuities, retirement, reinsurance, institutional products, or related insurance businesses.
* Experience with valuation, forecasting, asset liability management, capital planning, liquidity risk, stress testing, or strategic asset allocation.
* Knowledge of US GAAP, US statutory reporting, Bermuda EBS or BSCR, or comparable insurance accounting and regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with Prophet, MoSes, or comparable projection systems.
* Experience with cloud\-enabled platforms, Git\-based development, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment, data architecture, or Agile portfolio delivery.
* Experience building or expanding a modeling, analytics, actuarial, or finance capability within a global capability center.

* + **PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.**

**Skills:** Actuarial Modeling , Python Engineering , Leadership

6759cc7e.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
6759cc7e.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect \- Associate
* Experience creating and implementing large\-scale programs
* MBA, or 6\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* 3\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. 541d490d.title: Job Delivery Lead
541d490d.description:
The Job Delivery Lead is responsible for directing the field employee in safe, reliable, and efficient product and service delivery. The Job Delivery Lead is also responsible for driving customer satisfaction and service quality while ensuring an efficient cost structure, and drives field employee progression through competency development and performance evaluation. This person collaborates with the OU PSD or PSD Manager for job life cycle support including technical and incident management, and ensures systematic usage of standard work and risk management throughout the service delivery process. The Job Delivery Lead provides visibility regarding crew and associated functions’ SQ performance and improvement opportunities, and is responsible for the COSD (i.e.resource consumption.)
   

  

* Identify service category and sign off on staffing model (multiskilling, remote operations, crew size).
* Verify projected resource plan (assets, products, and workforce).
* Manage PSD risk life cycle for low\- and medium\-risk and short\-term high\-risk jobs.
* Review and approve technical job program.
* Perform, consolidate, and analyze JRAs and generate exemptions and MOCs as needed.
* Approve JRA based on job risk level and CA score.
* Conduct pre\- and postjob briefs for every job. Discuss and communicate risks and controls to field personnel.
* Manage incident life cycle for medium\- and low\-severity incidents, escalating as needed, and conduct incident response and recovery.
* Assist PSD Manager in incident investigation, validation of results, and reviews.
* Manage service delivery process to exceed customer expectations.
* Manage all job incidents and job changes, in the form of exemptions and MOCs.
* Manage quality control of all field deliverables.
* Ensure customer acceptance of service delivery.
* Ensure support to other functional processes with proper handoffs at key interfaces.
* Performs field operations as required.


 10\-12 years
   

  

 SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

**Description**
 If you are looking for an opportunity to solve deep technical problems and drive large\-scale cross\-functional initiatives in a fast\-paced environment working with smart, passionate engineers and business leaders, this might be the role for you.
   

  

 Within the Transportation Technology and Services organization, Relay Central delivers a seamless, intelligent, and trusted foundation that empowers Amazon’s middle mile carriers to thrive in a fast\-moving, complex environment. We believe that great products and experiences should enable carriers to focus on what matters most — safety, reliability, operational excellence, and growing their business with Amazon.
   

  

 Relay Central’s mission is to help carriers succeed while insisting on the highest standards across safety, compliance, trust, and delivery quality. We are building the systems, experiences, and operational mechanisms that simplify complexity, reduce friction, and create confidence for carriers operating within Amazon’s transportation network.
   

  

 By unifying essential capabilities into one cohesive experience, we enable smooth onboarding, effective trip management, trusted operational support, and engaging loyalty experiences. Our vision is to become the trusted control tower for carriers — delivering the right insights, tools, and intelligent experiences that unlock carrier potential and help shape the future of transportation.
   

  

 Our team is actively seeking motivated and multi\-talented individuals who are passionate about reinventing and transforming transportation and logistics operations while maintaining a relentless focus on customer trust and operational excellence.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead complex, cross\-functional programs that power the Relay Central platform and carrier experience. You will partner closely with engineering, product, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions that improve carrier success while upholding Amazon’s high bar for quality, reliability, and customer trust.
   

  

 You will own roadmap planning, dependency management, execution mechanisms, and delivery for strategic initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations. This role requires strong technical depth, excellent judgment, and the ability to influence across organizations. You should be a self\-starter with a bias for action who can balance long\-term vision with operational rigor in highly ambiguous environments.

 Use data\-driven decision making to improve customer outcomes and operational performance
   

  

 Help build a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and high standards across teams

 Exhibits excellent judgment
   

  

 Earns trust across technical and business teams
   

  

 Has relentlessly high standards and insists on operational excellence

 Thinks strategically while maintaining strong execution focus
   

  

 Demonstrates strong ownership and bias for action

 Thinks big while remaining customer obsessed
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**

 Experience driving roadmap strategy, execution planning, and release coordination

ce96e213.title: Senior Salesforce Consultant / Solution Architect – Sales & Service Cloud
ce96e213.description:
**Senior Salesforce Consultant / Solution Architect – Sales \& Service Cloud**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------


**Location:** Mysuru, India / Remote / Hybrid
  

**Engagement:** Permanent
  

**Level:** Senior Consultant / Solution Architect
  

**Industry:** Transportation \& Logistics
  

**Recruiting via:** Arj Global – Hiring Partner


### **About the Client**


Our client is a leading North American transportation and logistics provider. It delivers premium, time\-critical freight services to freight forwarders, airlines, third\-party logistics providers and large enterprise shippers. Its sales, customer service and revenue operations run on Salesforce every day.


### **The Role**


Salesforce is the commercial and service engine of the business. It is where customer relationships, pipeline, account hierarchies, ownership and day\-to\-day customer service come together.


As Senior Salesforce Consultant / Solution Architect, you will own the design, delivery and reliability of the enterprise Salesforce platform across **Sales Cloud and Service Cloud**. You will cover the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding through case management and ongoing account operations.


You will own the complete SDLC: consulting with the business, architecting solutions, building on the platform, integrating with the wider enterprise and keeping production stable. Salesforce consumes the customer golden record from an Oracle Fusion CDM master. Through **MuleSoft**, it connects to transportation management, billing, order management and finance systems.


**Why it matters:** sales, customer service and revenue operations depend on this platform daily. Your job is to keep it architecturally sound, reliably integrated and continuously improving.


### **What You’ll Do**


**Business Consulting \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Translate business objectives into Salesforce capabilities.
* Run requirements workshops, solution discovery and impact analysis.
* Advise Customer Service, Sales Operations, Credit and Billing teams on future\-state processes.
* Provide technical guidance on account management, hierarchies, ownership and compensation.

**Solution Architecture \& Design**


* Design enterprise\-grade solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and the customer lifecycle.
* Produce solution designs, architecture diagrams, process flows and technical specifications.
* Recommend scalable, secure designs aligned to Salesforce best practice and governor limits.
* Lead design reviews and platform architecture governance.

**Platform Development**


* Build with Apex, Triggers, Lightning Web Components and Flows.
* Deliver Platform Events, REST/SOAP APIs, Custom Objects, Custom Metadata, Validation Rules and Approval Processes.
* Enhance account and case management, routing, hierarchies, ownership and compensation.
* Build reusable, well\-tested components and reduce technical debt.

**Enterprise Integration**


* Design and maintain integrations with MuleSoft, the customer master, TMS, billing, order management and ERP.
* Define integration architecture, authentication standards, asynchronous patterns and error handling.
* Monitor interfaces and resolve synchronisation and data\-processing failures.

**Production Support \& Reliability**


* Resolve production incidents across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, integrations and automation.
* Monitor scheduled jobs, Batch and Queueable Apex, Platform Events, Flows and async processes.
* Lead root cause analysis so recurring issues get permanent fixes.
* Run proactive health checks to protect service levels and performance.

**Data Management \& Reconciliation**


* Reconcile data between Salesforce and integrated systems.
* Support migrations, bulk updates, duplicate management, cleansing and validation.
* Investigate discrepancies and coordinate fixes across enterprise applications.

**Release, DevOps \& Quality**


* Own the full SDLC: build, unit testing, SIT, UAT, deployment and post\-release validation.
* Coordinate releases using DevOps and CI/CD best practice with strong deployment governance.
* Carry out code reviews and performance tuning, and enforce governor\-limit compliance.

**Technical Leadership**


* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend improvements.
* Mentor developers and administrators, and set coding standards.
* Maintain specifications, runbooks, architecture diagrams and knowledge articles.

### **How Success Is Measured**


* **Platform stability:** lower incident volume, faster resolution and fewer repeat issues.
* **Integration health:** reliable, timely interfaces with MuleSoft, the customer master, TMS and billing.
* **Delivery quality:** on\-time, low\-defect releases through SIT and UAT.
* **Code quality:** governor\-limit compliance, test coverage and reduced technical debt.
* **Data integrity:** consistency across systems and fewer reconciliation exceptions.
* **Business enablement:** automation that measurably improves customer and revenue operations.

### **What You’ll Bring**


**Essential**


* 8\+ years of Salesforce experience across delivery and production support.
* Deep expertise in **Sales Cloud and Service Cloud**, including case management and the customer lifecycle.
* Strong hands\-on development with **Apex, LWC, Flows and Platform Events**.
* Proven experience with enterprise integrations using **MuleSoft** and APIs.
* Experience supporting large\-scale production orgs and complex automation.
* Ownership of end\-to\-end SDLC and DevOps / CI/CD release practices.

**Desirable**


* Salesforce Application Architect and/or System Architect.
* Platform Developer II.
* Administrator and Advanced Administrator.
* Sales Cloud Consultant and Service Cloud Consultant.
* Experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain or another high\-volume, integration\-heavy industry.
* Familiarity with an MDM platform, such as Oracle Fusion CDM, as an upstream source.
* Cloud experience, ideally Microsoft Azure.

### **Why Apply**


* A senior role with real ownership, from business consulting through architecture, build and production.
* A complex, integration\-rich enterprise landscape.
* Direct impact on the sales, service and revenue operations of a major logistics business.
**Job Type:** Full Time
**Job Location:** Mysuru

acfc3f34.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, UnifiedAuth
acfc3f34.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Unified Authorization is responsible for securing customer and corporate communication across all of Amazon. Whether it's the retail website, Alexa, or Kindle, we ensure actors are authenticated and authorized to take the requested action. Every aspect of Amazon's business interacts with our systems, including enabling the next generation of retail services on AWS infrastructure. As a global security provider, we're at the intersection of resiliency, availability, and the need to move at agile internet speed.
  

  

You are an experienced technical program manager who can work closely with product management and other business partners to define strategy and requirements, and help lead teams from concept through delivery and subsequent operation. You have regular communication with senior management on status, risks and product strategy. You have excellent listening, writing skills and very strong technical competency. You're a thought leader, but you don't just know how to solve the problem, you prove it by leading team to build the solution. Last but not the least; you have a high bar for quality and passion for design and architecture.
  

  

As the ideal candidate you will be experienced in working closely with a team of software development engineers and have a proven track record of working on complex software solutions using an agile methodology. You will have the ability to dive deep into the understanding of problems in order to help your team make the right decisions for the product and the business. You will have a proven track record of working across organizational lines. You will also be a strong communicator and will have proven abilities in managing through ambiguous situations.  

  

About the team  

Unified Auth is responsible for securing every service transaction within Amazon SDO’s service\-oriented architecture (SOA) by authenticating the services involved in the transaction, authorizing APIs access, and enforcing least\-privilege access to Amazon’s business data such as Cart, Order, Customer Identity, Item, Employee Information and more. Unified Auth’s systems are classified as Maximally Secure Applications (MSA) by Amazon Security as they control access to all Amazon services. Amazon’s SOA is large, complex, and ever\-growing. A single Amazon customer interaction such as adding an item into cart, proceeding to checkout, adding/changing payment methods, confirming purchase, etc. spans tens to hundreds of inter\-service interactions that must be secured and observed using Unified Auth’s systems. Stores, Alexa, Ring, IMDB, Prime Video, Advertisement, Selling Partners, Pharmacy, Ordering and Payments, Fulfillment Centers, and Amazon’s internal systems such as PXT rely on Unified Auth solutions to meet rising access control security and privacy standards, such as Digital Markets Act (DMA) compliance, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type II certification.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Job Description**
**Job Summary :**
 We are looking for a Senior Consultant with strong technical expertise to support the implementation of SymphonyAI SCPO solutions for global retail customers.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing role focused on US retailer rollout support, requiring close collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and implementation teams.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience across enterprise application development, integrations, middleware, databases, and cloud technologies, along with the ability to lead technical workshops, define solution architecture, and support successful implementation and go\-live activities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Technical Discovery \& Solution Design :
* Lead technical discovery sessions and workshops with customers to understand current system landscapes, integration needs, and technical requirements.
* Design scalable and secure technical solutions aligned with SymphonyAI SCPO capabilities and customer business objectives.
* Define architecture, data flows, integration patterns, and deployment approaches for implementation programs.
* Integration \& Technical Implementation :
* Support end\-to\-end integration efforts across enterprise systems, planning platforms, ERP systems, and third\-party applications.
* Configure and support REST APIs, middleware, messaging systems, and data integration pipelines.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and customer IT teams to ensure successful technical implementation.
* Application Development \& Technical Support :
* Provide hands\-on support across Java, Angular, .NET, shell scripting, and related technologies during implementation activities.
* Work with PL/SQL, Oracle databases, UNIX/Linux environments, and middleware platforms such as WebLogic and Glassfish.
* Support development and troubleshooting of J2EE, JSP, and web\-based application components.
* Testing, Deployment \& Go\-Live Support :
* Support integration testing, defect resolution, performance validation, and production readiness activities.
* Coordinate deployment support, go\-live activities, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Proactively identify technical risks and ensure timely issue resolution.
* Documentation \& Stakeholder Collaboration :
* Create technical design documents, integration specifications, environment setup guides, and deployment documentation.
* Work closely with customer stakeholders, implementation teams, and internal engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support knowledge transfer sessions and provide technical guidance to customers and internal teams.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

* Strong hands\-on experience with Java, Angular, .NET, and bash/shell scripting.

* Participate in architecture workshops, technical discussions, and client presentations.
* Work with implementation teams to ensure that the proposed solution aligns with the approved architecture.
* Review implementation approaches and provide technical guidance where required.
* Support troubleshooting and resolution of architecture and integration\-related issues.
* Assist in preparing implementation strategies, technical recommendations, and transition documents.

* Microsoft Sentinel
* Microsoft Defender
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
* Microsoft Defender for Office 365
* Microsoft Defender for Identity
* Microsoft Intune
* Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD
* Microsoft security and identity integrations
* SIEM/SOAR concepts
* Security monitoring and incident detection

Other Security Technologies

Exposure to the following technologies is preferred:

* **Proofpoint** – Email security and threat protection
* **CyberArk** – Privileged Access Management (PAM)

Hands\-on experience with one or more of these technologies will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.

You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

 What You'll Actually Be Doing
   

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


 You're Our Person If...
   

  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

340d5a68.title: Senior Enterprise Delivery Manager, Migrations
340d5a68.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Migration Strategy: Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**

2d578b38.title: Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Specialist
2d578b38.description:
**About Our Client**
 Our client is a growing SaaS company providing cloud\-based software that helps energy, utility, telecom, and infrastructure companies protect their critical network infrastructure. With nearly three decades of industry experience, the company serves customers across North America and continues to expand its platform with new data\-driven and AI\-powered capabilities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our client is building a governed, multi\-cloud data estate on
 **Databricks** 
 to power cross\-product insights. This role owns the cloud infrastructure and platform side that the Data Engineering, Data Science, MLOps, and Data Architecture teams depend on. You will provision and configure what these teams need in Databricks, in Azure (the backend for all Databricks solutions), and in AWS. Identity and Access Management is the core of the role, from IAM roles and access policies to the service principals that let other applications connect to Databricks. Requests often arrive through help desk tickets, but this is not a support position: your work is what allows the teams to move forward, faster and securely. The role is remote, based in India (Bangalore preferred, Pune also an option), Monday to Friday during standard business hours, with some overlap with the US team a few days a week.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provision, configure, and manage the core cloud infrastructure behind a Databricks\-based data estate, with Azure as the primary backend for Databricks and additional work in AWS.
* Make Azure configuration changes required for Databricks resources and settings to work as expected.
* Manage infrastructure components such as VPCs/VNets, subnets, route tables, network connectivity, S3 buckets and Azure Storage Accounts, compute resources, and private endpoints.
* Establish and maintain secure DEV, QA, and PROD environments with proper isolation and platform guardrails.
* Build, version, test, and deploy infrastructure changes through Infrastructure\-as\-Code, mainly Terraform (Azure ARM/Bicep and AWS CloudFormation also apply).
* Provision and manage IAM roles, service principals, managed identities, groups, and access policies across AWS, Azure, and Databricks.
* Create service principals so other applications can connect to Databricks and exchange results.
* Implement least\-privilege access and role\-based access control (RBAC), and support identity federation and automated identity lifecycle management (SSO, SCIM, SAML, OAuth).
* Review and process elevated or administrative access requests through controlled, auditable procedures, and take part in periodic access reviews.

* Solid understanding of security and governance, with the judgment to spot and correct security issues across the platform.
* Familiarity with cloud networking and security fundamentals: VPC/VNet architecture, subnets and routing, private connectivity, network segmentation, secrets management, encryption, and key management.
* Ability to quickly troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, identity, permission, and platform\-access issues.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain infrastructure and access issues clearly to technical teams.
* Familiarity with enterprise compliance and security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR), audit logging, and access reviews.
* Based in India, with Bangalore preferred and Pune also an option, and able to overlap with US hours a few days a week.


**Nice\-to\-Have**

**Description**
 Unified Authorization is responsible for securing customer and corporate communication across all of Amazon. Whether it's the retail website, Alexa, or Kindle, we ensure actors are authenticated and authorized to take the requested action. Every aspect of Amazon's business interacts with our systems, including enabling the next generation of retail services on AWS infrastructure. As a global security provider, we're at the intersection of resiliency, availability, and the need to move at agile internet speed.
   

  

 You are an experienced technical program manager who can work closely with product management and other business partners to define strategy and requirements, and help lead teams from concept through delivery and subsequent operation. You have regular communication with senior management on status, risks and product strategy. You have excellent listening, writing skills and very strong technical competency. You're a thought leader, but you don't just know how to solve the problem, you prove it by leading team to build the solution. Last but not the least; you have a high bar for quality and passion for design and architecture.
   

  

 As the ideal candidate you will be experienced in working closely with a team of software development engineers and have a proven track record of working on complex software solutions using an agile methodology. You will have the ability to dive deep into the understanding of problems in order to help your team make the right decisions for the product and the business. You will have a proven track record of working across organizational lines. You will also be a strong communicator and will have proven abilities in managing through ambiguous situations.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Unified Auth is responsible for securing every service transaction within Amazon SDO’s service\-oriented architecture (SOA) by authenticating the services involved in the transaction, authorizing APIs access, and enforcing least\-privilege access to Amazon’s business data such as Cart, Order, Customer Identity, Item, Employee Information and more. Unified Auth’s systems are classified as Maximally Secure Applications (MSA) by Amazon Security as they control access to all Amazon services. Amazon’s SOA is large, complex, and ever\-growing. A single Amazon customer interaction such as adding an item into cart, proceeding to checkout, adding/changing payment methods, confirming purchase, etc. spans tens to hundreds of inter\-service interactions that must be secured and observed using Unified Auth’s systems. Stores, Alexa, Ring, IMDB, Prime Video, Advertisement, Selling Partners, Pharmacy, Ordering and Payments, Fulfillment Centers, and Amazon’s internal systems such as PXT rely on Unified Auth solutions to meet rising access control security and privacy standards, such as Digital Markets Act (DMA) compliance, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type II certification.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

ee8843eb.title: Senior QA/DV Program Manager
ee8843eb.description:
Axiado is building the future of AIpowered digital infrastructure. We are a fastgrowing, wellfunded silicon, systems, and solutions company pioneering a new category of semiconductor called the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU) that combines advanced hardware security, AIdriven resilience and efficiency, and realtime platform management. Our technology protects the world’s most critical infrastructure—from data centers to nextgeneration cloud and AI platforms—by securing systems at the foundation levels of hardware, independent of host CPUs and operating systems.
   

  

 Founded in 2019 and now over 150 employees strong, Axiado has evolved into a recognized leader in the convergence of AI, security, and silicon innovation. We partner with and are actively engaged in commercial programs with multiple Tier 1 industry leaders, validating both our technology and our long\-term market trajectory. Axiado has also won numerous industry awards for our ground\-breaking products and technological innovations, including being named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Security, winning the 2025 Global InfoSec Award for Outstanding AI Security Solution, and being named a finalist for the Global Semiconductor Alliance’s 2025 “Start\-Up to Watch” award.
   

  

 At Axiado, developing breakthrough technology takes more than great engineering—it takes a team of exceptional people who collaborate boldly, challenge assumptions, and take pride in building what comes next. We value curiosity, execution, respect, and a shared desire to make a meaningful impact on the security and reliability of the digital world.
   

  

 If you’re driven to innovate, energized by hard problems, and excited to help define the future of secure AI infrastructure, we invite you to apply and join us on this journey.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Senior QA/DV Program Manager a highly skilled and driven Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the execution, delivery, and quality assurance of multiple ASIC SOC hardware and BMC software solutions portfolios. In this role, you will lead the program management for our End\-to\-End Quality Assurance (QA) team, and drive the program execution for our complex SOC Design Verification projects (DV).
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to work closely with various engineering teams, from HW/SW design, verification, validation and system integration.
   

  

 Program Management \& Execution
   

  

* Multi\-Project Lifecycle Ownership: Track multiple parallel ASIC SOC projects from pre\-silicon phases through to final deployment.
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Coordinate schedules and dependencies between QA, Software, Architecture, Design, and DV teams.
* Risk Mitigation \& Resolution: Identify technical and schedule bottlenecks early to develop clear mitigation plans.
* Metrics \& Reporting: Report key execution metrics and milestone readiness regularly to engineering leadership.


 QA Program Focus
   

  

* System\-Level QA Strategy: Oversee the testing schedule for full server systems and BMC boards hosting the SOC.
* Bug Tracking \& Resolution: Drive the end\-to\-end triaging, tracking, and closure of system\-level defects with engineering teams.
* Hardware/Software Co\-Verification: Manage program dependencies for QA teams validating firmware, security layers, and Linux OS.
* Automation \& Infrastructure: Track the deployment of automated test regressions running on physical server infrastructure.


 DV Program Focus
   

  

* Milestone Tracking \& Delivery: Drive schedule adherence for block\-level, subsystem, and full\-chip verification milestones.
* Bug Lifecycle Management: Monitor pre\-silicon bug burn\-down rates and prioritize critical fixes to keep tape\-out schedules on track.
* Scope Tracking: Coordinate with DV team leads to ensure timelines account for coverage all critical components.
* Emulation \& Pre\-Silicon Planning: Drive reviews, schedule and track dependencies for emulation and FPGA development, and coordinate with design, DV and software teams.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Experience: 7\+ years as a Technical Program Manager managing complex silicon or system\-level validation programs.
* Systems QA Expertise: Strong understanding of system\-level QA frameworks, automated test setups, and server or BMC testing.
* Silicon Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with multi\-CPU SOC architectures, hardware security, and interfaces like PCIe, USB, or Ethernet.
* Verification Fundamentals: Basic grasp of pre\-silicon Design Verification concepts, coverage metrics, and bug\-tracking lifecycles.
* Tools \& Methodologies: Proven proficiency with project management tools like Jira and standard hardware/software release processes.
* Preferred qualifications:
+ Advanced Degree: Master’s degree in EE, CE, CS, or a technical MBA.
+ AI Productivity Tools: Proficiency using AI\-based tools for program management optimization, action\-item tracking, and automated meeting minutes.
+ BMC \& Server Ecosystem: Direct experience with Baseboard Management Controllers, embedded Linux, or IPMI/Redfish protocols.
+ Security Frameworks: Understanding of hardware Root\-of\-Trust, cryptographic accelerators, and secure boot architectures.


**Additional Information**
 Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent.
   

  

 We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real\-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are.
   

  

 Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

**FICO (NYSE: FICO)** 
 is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100\+ countries make better decisions. Join our world\-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Business Partner in our Domain Risk Pre\-Sales unit, you'll identify and cultivate new opportunities related to credit and fraud risk, combining deep business knowledge across both domains with a consultative, solutions\-based approach to selling. This role focuses on building new revenue streams through the expansion of FICO Platform capabilities, working closely with the Asia Pacific sales team to translate client business challenges into compelling and credible solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Contribute**
* Partner with clients on discovery and scoping sessions to uncover business challenges and growth opportunities, then develop proposals and business cases that demonstrate value.
* Contribute to client account plans and lead deal structuring and negotiations, working with internal teams to shape and position solutions that protect existing business and win new deals.
* Contribute to go\-to\-market strategy and market sizing, tracking industry trends and maintaining a strong grasp of our products and the competitive landscape.
* Support innovation workshops, quarterly business reviews, and PoC/PoV engagements, acting as a credit and fraud risk subject matter expert for financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications clients.
* Apply your knowledge of the risk management lifecycle, including originations, customer management, fraud, collections, and digital transformation, to build platform demos with Key Account Managers, Solution Sales Executives, and Platform Presales teams.
* Develop strategic plans, proposals, business cases, and executive presentations, tailoring content for audiences ranging from technical teams to C\-level executives.
* Build FICO Platform brand awareness and thought leadership through social media, case studies, blogs, white papers, webinars, and event presentations.
* Up to 50% travel across the region.


**What We’re Seeking**
* Exceptional executive\-level communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to engage C\-suite stakeholders, boards, and senior leadership, translating complex business insights and technical detail into business impact, ROI, and actionable strategy across strategic planning documents, proposals, and business cases.
* Experience in credit and/or fraud risk management, with a proven track record of achieving meaningful loss reduction and/or customer experience improvements, complemented by sales experience as a vendor and demonstrated project leadership and results orientation.
* Comprehensive understanding of the risk management lifecycle across the entire customer journey, with senior\-level expertise across multiple credit and fraud risk domains including originations, transactional/payment fraud, online/mobile banking fraud, application fraud, first party fraud, customer management, and collections.
* Extensive experience working with payment processors, payment gateways, payment networks, issuers, and acquirers, including authorization flows, real\-time decisioning, and processor, gateway, and network\-specific operating models.
* End\-user knowledge of credit and fraud risk management solutions, authorization systems, authentication solutions, loan origination systems, and other decision management platforms.
* Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, data science, or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.


**Our Offer to You**
* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people\-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.


**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
 At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest\-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
   

  

 FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
   

  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


 Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
   

  

 Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
   

  

 FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. The successful candidate will work closely with sales, technical consultants, delivery teams, product specialists, and commercial teams to support the development of relevant and competitive solutions for prospective customers.
 



  





**Location \- Hyderabad**

 Assist in understanding customer business requirements, challenges, and expected outcomes. Review Requests for Proposal, Requests for Information, and other customer documents.

 Document customer requirements in a structured format.
 



**2\. Proposal and Bid Support:**

 Maintain proposal templates, case studies, company profiles, and supporting documents.

**3\. Solution Development Support:** 




 Work with technical and functional experts to understand the proposed solution.

 Support the development of high\-level solution diagrams, process flows, and delivery models.
 



 Conduct basic research on relevant technologies, products, industry trends, and competitor offerings.
 



 Help align the proposed solution with customer requirements and business objectives.
 



**4\. Presentation and Demonstration Support:**

 Participate in customer meetings and document key discussion points and action items.
 



**5\. Sales Support and Opportunity Management:** 




 Support the sales team during opportunity qualification and proposal development.

 Maintain trackers for opportunities, proposals, deadlines, approvals, and customer responses.
 



 Assist in preparing internal deal review and management approval presentations.
 



 Support handover of won opportunities from sales and presales teams to delivery teams.
 



**6\. Knowledge Management:** 




 Maintain a central repository of proposals, solution documents, case studies, credentials, resumes, and reusable content.

1ffe2c39.title: Solution Engineer - Context Graph Demo Specialist
1ffe2c39.description:
**Solution Engineer \- Context Graph Demo Specialist** 




  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Gurugram
 



  





**Experience:** 
 Fresher to 2 Years
 



  





**Role Type** 
 : Individual Contributor (IC)
 



**Travel** 
 : 40\-50% (on\-site customer demos)
 



  





 About the Role
 



 Tata Communications is looking for an early\-career Solution Engineer to join the Solution Engineering team, focused on building and delivering demonstrations of our Context Graph capabilities. This is a highly visible, customer\-facing role for someone who enjoys translating technical concepts into compelling business stories, thinks logically under pressure, and is comfortable being on the road to present in front of customers.
 



 You'll work closely with senior solution architects, product, and sales teams to build demo environments, customize them for specific customer use cases, and present them live both virtually and on\-site.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Demo Build \& Ownership: Build, configure, and maintain demo environments for Context Graph, ensuring they reflect current product capabilities and are tailored to different industry use cases.
 



 Customer\-Facing Demos: Travel to customer locations (40\-50% travel) to deliver live product demonstrations, walk through use cases, and answer first\-level technical questions.
 



 Use Case Translation: Work with sales and solution architects to understand a prospect's business problem and translate it into a relevant, believable demo narrative not just a feature walkthrough.
 



 Troubleshooting on the Fly: Diagnose and resolve demo environment issues quickly, including during live customer sessions, with a calm and structured approach.
 



 Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to stay current on roadmap changes, feedback loops from the field, and competitive positioning.
 



 Documentation: Maintain demo scripts, environment setup guides, and reusable assets so demos can scale across the team.
 



 Continuous Learning: Build depth in graph data concepts, knowledge graphs, and how Context Graph fits into broader enterprise data and AI strategies.
 



  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




 Must\-Have:
 



 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (freshers welcome) or up to 2 years of relevant experience.
 



 Strong logical and analytical thinking able to break down a customer problem and map it to a technical solution.
 



  





 Ontology\-first thinking demonstrated ability to model an enterprise s objects, actions and processes as a reusable semantic layer, with metadata, permissions and data structures kept consistent, secure, and scalable Ontology.
 



 Basic understanding of data structures, databases, or graph concepts (formal experience not required, but genuine curiosity and aptitude expected).
 



 Good business acumen able to understand a customer's commercial context, not just their technical ask.
 



 Comfortable with public speaking / presenting to small and large groups, including senior stakeholders.
 



 Willingness and ability to travel 40\-50% of the time for on\-site customer demos.
 



 Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
 



  





 Good to Have (not mandatory):
 



 Exposure to graph databases (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, etc.) or knowledge graph concepts.
 



 Familiarity with SQL, Python, or basic scripting.
 



 Prior internship or project experience involving customer\-facing work, hackathons, or product demos.
 



 Understanding of enterprise IT, telecom, or B2B SaaS environments.
 



  





  





 What Success Looks Like in This Role
 



 Demo environments are reliable, current, and reusable across the team.
 



 Customers leave demo sessions with a clear understanding of how Context Graph solves their specific problem.
 



 You build a reputation internally as someone who can be trusted to represent the product in front of a customer.
 



 You progress toward owning more complex, custom\-built demos and eventually pre\-sales solutioning independently.
 



  





  





 Why Join Tata Communications
 



 Front\-row seat to how enterprise customers evaluate and adopt cutting\-edge graph and AI\-driven solutions.
 



 Direct mentorship from senior solution architects and exposure to the full sales cycle.
 



 Fast\-tracked learning curve: technical depth \+ commercial exposure \+ customer\-facing skills, all in one role.
 



 Clear growth path into Solution Architecture, Pre\-Sales, or Product roles.

12428f3d.title: Pre-Sales Engineer
12428f3d.description:
We're Hiring — Pre\-Sales AV Specialist \| Arihant Infosys \| Hyderabad
 



  





 📍 Hyderabad \| 🤝 Arihant Infosys \| 💼 Presales \| AV Solutions
 



  





 Arihant Infosys has been transforming business communications since 1992\. As a long\-established audio\-visual solutions provider, we partner with global brands including LG, Philips, Sony, Liantronics, Harman, JBL, AKG, AMX, BSS, Crown, and Delta to deliver high\-quality AV solutions across video conferencing, professional displays, digital signage, automation, direct view LED, and advanced audio systems.
 



 We're expanding our Pune team and looking for a Pre\-Sales AV Specialist who can own the technical front end of the sales cycle — from client requirement discovery to demo, proposal, and solution design. This is not a support\-desk role. You'll be the technical voice in the room when a client is deciding whether Arihant is the right partner for their AV investment.
 



  





 Who this is NOT for
 


* If you've only ever followed a script for demos someone else built, this isn't for you.
* If you think of presales as ticket\-closing rather than deal\-winning, this is the wrong role.
* If you're not comfortable explaining signal flow, room acoustics, or a BOQ to a client who's never heard those terms, you'll struggle here.
* If you need every solution pre\-packaged before you walk into a client meeting, you won't have the range this role demands.



  





 What you're getting into
 


* Own the technical presales journey — requirement gathering, solution design, demos, and proposal support — for video conferencing, professional displays, digital signage, automation, direct view LED, and audio systems.
* Design and present AV solutions tailored to client requirements, working closely with the sales team to convert opportunities.
* Configure and run live demos and proof\-of\-concepts for prospective clients, ensuring the equipment and setup reflect what's actually being proposed.
* Prepare technical documentation — BOQs, solution schematics, and configuration notes — that sales and delivery teams can act on without back\-and\-forth.
* Coordinate with OEM partners and vendors on product specifications, pricing, and availability to keep proposals accurate and competitive.
* Provide on\-site and pre\-sales technical support for meetings, client walkthroughs, and events, troubleshooting issues on the spot when they come up.
* Be the technical point of contact between the client and the sales team throughout the pre\-sales cycle.



  





 Who you are
 


* Hands\-on experience with AV Systems — professional displays, video conferencing platforms, digital signage, LED walls, and audio equipment.
* Comfortable configuring and demoing video conferencing hardware and related AV control systems.
* Able to systematically troubleshoot AV issues — signal flow, connectivity, and configuration problems — under time pressure.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions clearly to clients with varied technical backgrounds.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts as they apply to AV and conferencing systems is an advantage.
* Relevant technical certification or diploma in electronics, IT, or AV technology preferred.
* Willingness to travel locally for client site visits, demos, and events, and to manage time effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* 1–4 years of experience in AV presales, technical sales support, or AV systems integration preferred.



 Location:
 
 Hyderabad
 




 Employment type: Full\-time
 



  





 Interested candidates can apply directly on LinkedIn or share their resume.
