0e240b6b.title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
0e240b6b.description:
**Company Description**  

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over **2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries**, supported **by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals**. With **more than 145 years of service excellence**, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve t**he highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.**


Our brand promise – **“when you need to be sure”** – underscores our commitment to **trust, integrity and reliability**, enabling businesses to **thrive with confidence**. We proudly deliver our **expert services** through the **SGS name** and a portfolio of **trusted specialized brands**, including **Applied Technical Services**, **Brightsight**, **Bluesign** and **Nutrasource**.

 **Job Description**  

The Senior Azure Cloud Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and evolving the organization's Microsoft Azure cloud architecture strategy, with Azure positioned as the primary enterprise cloud platform. The role ensures Azure environments are secure, scalable, resilient, cost\-effective, and aligned with business objectives, while maintaining awareness of AWS and Google Cloud Platform capabilities where required for interoperability or future\-state planning.


The Cloud Architect works closely with enterprise architects, cybersecurity teams, application owners, DevOps engineers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to drive cloud adoption, modernization initiatives, and digital transformation programs.


Responsibilities

**Azure Strategy \& Architecture**

* Develop and maintain Azure architecture roadmaps aligned with business and technology strategies.
* Define target\-state architectures, modernization approaches, and cloud migration strategies.
* Establish Azure architecture standards, reference patterns, and governance guardrails for secure enterprise\-scale adoption.
* Apply the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well\-Architected Framework to guide cloud design, governance, and modernization initiatives.
* Promote Azure as the primary cloud platform while supporting interoperability with AWS and GCP where required.

**Azure Platform Design \& Landing Zones**

* Lead the design, governance, and evolution of Azure Landing Zones.
* Define subscription strategies, management groups, resource organization, naming standards, tagging, and policy controls.
* Design secure Azure networking and hybrid connectivity architectures, including hub\-and\-spoke, private connectivity, DNS, and segmentation.
* Architect solutions across Azure IaaS, PaaS, containers, data, analytics, integration, AI, disaster recovery, and business continuity services.
* Establish security baselines using Azure Policy, RBAC, Microsoft Entra ID, Defender for Cloud, Key Vault, and monitoring capabilities.
* Ensure integration between Azure, on\-premises, and other cloud environments where required.

**Governance, Compliance \& Security**

* Define and maintain cloud governance frameworks aligned with security, risk, compliance, and operational requirements.
* Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations, including ISO 27001, ISO 22301, SOC 2, GDPR, and NIS2\.
* Design secure\-by\-default cloud architectures using Zero Trust principles, identity and access management, encryption, monitoring, and threat protection services.
* Conduct architecture reviews, security assessments, and design assurance activities using Azure Well\-Architected principles.

**Cloud Migration \& Modernization**

* Lead cloud transformation and migration initiatives.
* Assess workloads and define migration strategies, including rehost, replatform, refactor, retire, and replace approaches.
* Drive application modernization, containerization, and cloud\-native adoption.

**FinOps, DevOps \& Automation**

* Develop cloud cost optimization and governance strategies, including KPIs and reporting.
* Promote Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, and cloud\-native architecture practices.
* Support the adoption of DevOps and Platform Engineering capabilities.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Provide cloud architecture leadership across global initiatives.
* Present technical solutions to technical and business stakeholders, including executive leadership.
* Mentor engineering and operations teams and serve as a trusted advisor on cloud strategy and architecture decisions.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 8\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, systems engineering, or architecture.
* 5\+ years designing and implementing Azure cloud solutions at enterprise scale.
* Proven experience with Azure Landing Zones, cloud governance, security, and modernization initiatives.
* Experience integrating Azure with on\-premises environments. Exposure to AWS and/or GCP is desirable.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well\-Architected Framework.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, including networking, governance, security, identity management, monitoring, and cost optimization.
* Experience with Azure services such as AKS, App Services, API Management, Azure Monitor, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM) and CI/CD automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.
* Solid understanding of cloud security, including Microsoft Entra ID, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Azure Policy, RBAC, and Key Vault.
* Experience with containerization and Kubernetes.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Azure Administrator Associate and/or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
* CCSP, TOGAF, or CKA.
* AWS and GCP architect certifications are advantageous.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and enterprise architecture.
* Leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* Strong communication and presentation abilities.
* Problem solving, innovation, and risk management.

  

**Additional Information** **Why SGS?**

* Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.
* Enjoy a **flexible schedule and a hybrid work model.**
* Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.
* Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents.

**Apply Now**:  

At SGS, we are committed to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential. Apply now to join our motivated and dynamic team!

774c50a3.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Automotive & Manufacturing
774c50a3.description:
**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) Automotive and Manufacturing team is looking for an experienced and motivated technologist who possesses a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will partner with some of the world's largest automotive and manufacturing firms, AWS Sales and other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services.
   

  

 This role will drive AWS technology adoption and revenue growth across assigned automotive and manufacturing customers. As a trusted customer advocate, the Senior Solutions Architect will work directly with leading industrial manufacturers as they reimagine how things are designed, built, and operated. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers navigate architectural decisions across connected vehicle platforms, digital twins, smart factory/Industry 4\.0 initiatives, supply chain optimization, and software\-defined vehicle (SDV) strategies.
   

  

 As a key member of the Account Team, you will guide customers' architectural choices across use cases involving IoT, edge computing, high\-performance computing (HPC), security, data lakes and analytics, AI/ML, simulation, and robotics — as well as foundational services spanning compute, storage, and networking. You will provide technical design guidance and thought leadership, contribute to best\-practice knowledge sharing within the broader AWS Solutions Architecture community, and help develop reusable industry reference architectures.
   

  

 The ideal candidate must be self\-motivated with a proven track record in software/technology architecture or consulting. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
   

  

 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for connecting with, educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for automotive and manufacturing customers.
* Have a strong understanding of large\-scale, mission\-critical solutions in the automotive and manufacturing industry. The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a systems engineer/architect in the automotive or manufacturing sector. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep\-dive education and design exercises to create solutions built on AWS.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned Automotive and Manufacturing accounts, engaging Director\-level engineering leaders and senior technical stakeholders.
* Architect and design scalable, secure, and cost\-effective cloud solutions for industry\-specific workloads including connected vehicle data platforms, digital twin environments, MES/SCADA cloud integration, and smart factory deployments.
* Bridge IT and OT — connect traditional enterprise IT architectures with operational technology (OT) environments on the shop floor and at the edge, leveraging AWS IoT, edge, and hybrid services.
* Develop and execute technical account plans aligned with customers' business objectives and digital transformation roadmaps.
* Lead proof\-of\-concept engagements and architectural reviews to accelerate customer adoption and de\-risk production deployments.
* Provide customer feedback to AWS service teams and advocate for industry\-relevant feature development.
* Contribute to industry thought leadership — create reference architectures, blog posts, and reusable technical assets for the vertical.
* Present at AWS events (re:Invent, Summits, industry conferences) and participate in customer technical workshops.
* Share knowledge and best practices with peers in the Solutions Architecture community, contributing to technical community development.
* Stay current with industry megatrends (electrification, SDV, Industry 4\.0, sustainability) and connect them with AWS capabilities to drive customer outcomes.


**About The Team**
 The Automotive and Manufacturing Solutions Architecture team is a specialized group of technologists passionate about helping the world's leading vehicle manufacturers, industrial companies, and mobility innovators transform through cloud. We work at the intersection of current technology and physical\-world engineering — from the factory floor to the connected car to the autonomous future. Our team values deep industry expertise, intellectual curiosity, and a builder mentality.
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience communicating across technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience architecting or deploying Cloud/Virtualization solutions in enterprise customers
* Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics).
* Working knowledge of at least two of the following domains: IoT/edge computing, data analytics/data lakes, AI/ML, HPC, DevOps/CI\-CD, or application modernization.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with automation and any version control tools, or experience with web\-based applications and HTTP and experience in any Bigdata architecture
* Familiarity with Industry 4\.0 concepts: digital twins, predictive maintenance, computer vision for quality inspection, and manufacturing execution systems.


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. **COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.  




### **OVERVIEW:**

### **This role of Sr. Technical Engineer in Analytics Platform team will be responsible for providing** **enterprise ownership and governance for shared data and ontology components in Palantir** **, ensuring they are well\-managed, reusable, and fit for long\-term scale. The role acts as the central point of coordination for ontology change management, standards enforcement, health monitoring, and stakeholder communication, while bridging business, data, and engineering teams to translate enterprise needs into robust, high\-quality Foundry components.**

  

### **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

  

* ### **Own the architecture, governance, and strategic direction for shared data and end\-to\-end capabilities in Palantir.**
* ### **Serve as the senior consultant for enterprise/shared objects, actions, metadata, and architectural exceptions.**
* ### **Define ownership, lifecycle, decision rights, and accountability models for shared components.**
* ### **Provide architectural oversight of Palantir Foundry platform operations, reliability, scalability, and performance.**
* ### **Own platform management and governance, including access control, Foundry API\-based automation, and administrative support.**
* ### **Provide product architecture consultation for new solution designs and optimization of existing implementations, aligned with industry’s best practices.**
* ### **Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable technical architectures.**
* ### **Lead architecture assessments, design reviews, technology evaluations, and solution recommendations across the Foundry ecosystem.**
* ### **Guide teams through implementation, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, reference architectures, and governance principles.**
* ### **Identify technical risks, dependencies, integration impacts, and opportunities for reuse before execution.**
* ### **Support delivery teams in resolving architectural challenges and ensure successful implementation of approved designs.**
* ### **Lead the evaluation and adoption of new platform offerings and releases by assessing capabilities, advocating for change requests, and driving timely, transparent implementation.**
* ### **Define and govern enterprise standards for data modelling, ontology design, metadata, security, documentation, and reuse.**
* ### **Drive adoption of architecture principles and best practices across delivery teams and consuming squads.**
* ### **Establish health checks for shared components covering usage, performance, data quality, security, and deprecation needs.**
* ### **Own authoritative documentation for end\-to\-end components, including applications, definitions, ownership, lifecycle, and usage guidance.**
* ### **Monitor adoption, quality, risk, and technical debt to guide continuous improvement and investment.**
* ### **Communicate architectural direction, governance decisions, risks, and business impacts to technical and executive stakeholders.**
* ### **Lead change enablement for major ontology, data\-platform, and Foundry capability changes.**
* ### **Facilitate alignment across product, engineering, data, architecture, security, and business teams.**
* ### **Translate business priorities into scalable, reusable, and governed ontology and data\-platform capabilities.**
* ### **Partner with product owners, data stewards, architects, and engineering leaders to establish common enterprise concepts.**
* ### **Ensure enterprise components support interoperability, scalability, maintainability, and long\-term business value.**
* ### **Guide teams in balancing delivery speed with architectural integrity, platform sustainability, and total cost of ownership.**
* ### **Mentor technical engineers and architects and raise architecture maturity across the organization.**
* ### **Define the architecture and priorities for automated workflows, controls, and observability within Palantir Foundry.**
* ### **Sponsor real\-time health metrics for proactive management of ontology quality, platform performance, adoption, and risk.**
* ### **Use operational insights to identify systemic issues, prioritize improvements, and enhance platform governance.**
* ### **Safeguard platform health through proactive monitoring and analytics, improving visibility, standardization, value realization, and overall system reliability.**

  

### **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* ### **Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.**
* ### **Understanding of Palantir platform capabilities – Permissions \& Controls, Data scheduling, ETL, Ontology Management, Downstream applications (Workshop, Slate, Map, Etc.).**
* ### **Ability to leverage Palantir Foundry tools and functionalities to build scalable and robust data solutions that meet business requirements.**
* ### **Ability to design and develop data integration pipelines within Platform (Palantir Foundry) to ingest, transform, and integrate data from various sources.**
* ### **Proficiency in programming languages such as PySpark, Python, typescript, or Scala.**
* ### **Experience with scripting languages and data manipulation tools to automate tasks and optimize data workflows within Platform (Palantir Foundry)**
* ### **Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.**

  

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

* ### **Good knowledge of Platform Management, Data Engineering \& Architecture, AI, ML, ETL, Application Development Experience.**
* ### **Excellent academics**
* ### **Results\-oriented, high energy, self\-motivated**
* ### **High level understanding of Platforms and GCP Cloud architecture**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L3\) at NTT DATA, your primary role will be to provide exceptional service to our clients by proactively identifying and resolving technical incidents. You will ensure that client infrastructure is configured, tested, and operational, leveraging your deep technical expertise to solve complex problems and enhance our service quality.
   

  

 Part of your Responsibilities will entail pre\-emptive service incident resolution, product reviews, and operational improvements. You will manage high\-complexity tickets, perform advanced tasks, and provide diverse solutions while ensuring zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions. Your role will also involve mentoring junior team members and working across various technology domains such as Cloud, Security, Networking, and Applications.
   

  

 You will conduct necessary checks, apply monitoring tools, and respond to alerts, identifying issues before they become problems. Logging incidents with the required level of detail, you will analyse, assign, and escalate support calls. Additionally, you will proactively identify opportunities for optimization and automation, ensuring continuous feedback to clients and affected parties.
   

  

 Important responsibility is to create knowledge articles for frequent tasks/issues and train junior team members in executing those tasks. Provide inputs to automation teams to reduce manual efforts.
   

  

 You will engage with third\-party vendors when necessary and keep systems and portals updated as prescribed. As a senior engineer, you will coach L2 teams on advanced troubleshooting techniques and support the implementation and delivery of projects, disaster recovery functions, and more, ensuring all actions adhere to client requirements and timelines.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Extensive Managed Services experience handling complex cross\-technology infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes.
* Proven experience working with vendors and/or third parties.
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Effective planning skills, even in changing circumstances.
* Positive outlook and ability to work well under pressure.
* Active listening skills and adaptability to changing client needs.
* Client\-focused approach to create positive client experiences throughout their journey.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).


**Workplace type:**
 On\-site Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R\&D.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
   

  

**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
 NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters—whether in writing or by phone—in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an
 **@nttdata.com** 
 email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please
 *contact us* 
 .

City: Pune
State/Province: Maharashtra
Posting Start Date: 10/1/26
Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.  

**Manager \- Procure to Pay (P2P– C1\)**

**Job Summary**

The Procure to Pay Manager oversees the end\-to\-end procurement and accounts payable lifecycle, ensuring efficient processing of purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoice management, vendor payments, travel \& expenses, and supplier relationship management. The role drives compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and continuous improvement across P2P operations.


**Key Responsibilities**

**P2P Operations Management**

* Lead and manage end\-to\-end Procure\-to\-Pay processes for 80\+ associates including managing end to end P2P transitions
* Ensure accurate and timely processing of purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoices, and payments.
* Monitor workflow queues, SLA adherence, and operational performance.
* Manage exception handling and issue resolution across the P2P cycle.

**Accounts Payable Management**

* Oversee invoice processing and payment execution activities.
* Ensure timely vendor payments and resolution of blocked invoices.
* Manage payment runs, AP aging, vendor statements, and reconciliations.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls and financial policies. **Procurement \& Vendor Management**
* Manage purchase order creation and compliance.
* Support supplier onboarding and vendor master governance.
* Drive supplier relationship management and issue resolution.
* Ensure adherence to procurement policies, contracts, and delegated authority matrices.

**Travel \& Expense (T\&E)**

* Oversee employee expense reimbursement processes.
* Ensure compliance with company travel and expense policies.
* Manage audit reviews and exception reporting.
* Drive automation and simplification of T\&E processes.

**Compliance, Controls \& Audit**

* Ensure adherence to company policies, SOX requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Monitor control compliance and implement corrective actions.
* Drive governance around segregation of duties and approval compliance.

**Stakeholder \& Client Management**

* Act as primary contact for business stakeholders, procurement teams, vendors, and clients.
* Conduct governance reviews and operational performance discussions.
* Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Provide insights and recommendations to leadership teams.

**People Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop team members.
* Drive employee engagement, training, and succession planning.
* Manage workload allocation, productivity, and performance management.
* Build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Continuous Improvement \& Transformation**

* Identify automation opportunities including Agentic AI deployment across procurement and AP processes.
* Drive process standardization and digitization initiatives.
* Improve cycle times, productivity, and service quality.
* Leverage ERP and workflow tools for operational excellence.
* Audit Findings and Control Compliance
* Automation Savings
**͏**
-----


**Do**
======

* **Maximize process efficiency and cost effectiveness through strategic planning, contract compliance and governance mechanisms**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* ### ***Strategy Planning with Senior Stakeholders***


	+ Collaborate with leaders to provide strategic and operational plans associated with the account
	+ Plan the strategy for the coming years by identifying new geographies for alternate revenue streams
	+ Ensure a deep enough understanding of clients individual experiences to head off potential issues before they become problems
* ### ***Contract compliance \& adherence***


	+ Ensure all SLA parameters are met in the account and maintain a green card at all times
	+ Review and drive appropriate actions/ systemic changes on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliances are cited
	+ Monitor and review the account on various delivery parameters to ensure quality delivery as per budget and timelines
**͏**
-----


* ### ***Delivery governance in the account***


	+ Understand customer goals and key performance metrics and ensure exceeding those goals throughout the project
	+ Ensure a green card for all accounts in terms of performance and quality
	+ Monitor and review delivery dashboards/ MIS across accounts to track progress and identify potential red flags
	+ Participate and share account performance across operational, quality and fulfillment parameters with internal and external stakeholders
	+ Lead and manage project escalations, potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to eliminate any revenue leakage
	+ Ensure regular invoicing as per the contract terms and condition
	+ Forecast and track key account metrics
* ### **Invoicing**


	+ Timely submission of invoices to the client as defined in the SOW
	+ Provide information required and resolve any invoicing issues raised by the client
* ### **Collect and analyze statistics (costs, customer service metrics etc.)**
* ### **Assume responsibility of budgeting and tracking expenses**
**͏**
-----


* **Ensure outstanding performance against key metrics mentioned in the agreement**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* ### **Regular cadence around contract compliance**


	+ Evaluate performance with key metrics (accuracy, customer service metrics etc.)
	+ Set direction for the team, track progress against targets through regular cadence calls and course correct as require
	+ Drive the focus of the team on quality and adherence to contract compliance processes
	+ Drive and implement structured cadence around quality, both process and transactional
	+ Cadence with delivery lead to ensure margins are met and the account numbers are at par to what is committed
	+ Weekly calls with WFM to ensure resource optimization, compliance to the manpower numbers agreed in the contract, future planning in case of ramp ups etc.
**͏**
-----


* Resource Allocation \& Retention
	+ Conduct effective resource planning to maximize the productivity of resources (people, technology etc.)
	+ Review and monitor resource planning and fulfillment in line with account requirements and costs of delivery
	+ Optimize manpower and minimize leakages by working closely with delivery head
	+ Ensure retention by offering relevant trainings and certifications of all allocated resources
	+ Lead one\-on\-one floor connect and other engagement activities to improve stickiness of the delivery team
Collaborate and influence internal key stakeholders to manage and resolve issues to ensure fulfillment and flawless delivery of projects  
* 
Mandatory Skills: Invoice to Pay(Transactional Accounting) .  

Experience: 8\-10 Years .  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

**Manager \- Record to Report (R2R – C1\)**

**Job Summary**

The R2R Manager is responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end accounting and financial reporting processes, ensuring accurate and timely month\-end close, compliance with accounting standards, strong financial controls, and continuous process improvement. The role manages teams supporting General Ledger, Account Reconciliation, Fixed Assets, Intercompany Accounting, Financial Reporting, and Statutory Compliance.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Close \& Reporting**

* Lead service delivery for 70\+ resources in end\-to\-end RtR, lead month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end closing activities including transitioning of complex RtR processes
* Ensure timely preparation and review of financial statements and management reports.
* Monitor close calendar adherence and reporting deadlines.
* Review trial balances, journal entries, accruals, provisions, and adjustments.

**General Ledger \& Reconciliations**

* Ensure accuracy and integrity of General Ledger accounts.
* Review and approve journal entries.
* Drive balance sheet account reconciliations and resolution of open items.
* Oversee intercompany reconciliation and consolidation activities.

**Compliance \& Controls**

* Ensure compliance with IFRS, US GAAP, local statutory requirements, and company policies.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Strengthen financial controls and governance frameworks.
* Monitor SOX and audit\-related requirements where applicable.

**Team Leadership**

* Manage, coach, and develop R2R team members.
* Conduct performance reviews and career development discussions.
* Drive employee engagement and capability\-building initiatives.
* Allocate work and monitor productivity and service levels.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as key contact for clients, business finance teams, controllers, auditors, and leadership teams.
* Provide financial insights and support decision\-making.
* Escalate key risks, issues, and dependencies proactively.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify automation and standardization opportunities including workflow and Agentic AI deployment
* Improve close efficiency, reporting quality, and process controls.
* Drive transformation initiatives and KPI improvements.
* Implement best practices for reconciliation, journal processing, and reporting. \[Record to...s

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Days to Close
* Journal Entry Accuracy

* Audit Findings
* SLA Compliance
* Productivity and Quality Metrics

* Customer Satisfaction Scores

* MBA Finance, CA, CMA, CPA, or ACCA preferred.

105b4d67.description:
About the Role
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Delivery Manager** 
 with a strong technical background and proven experience managing complex technology programs, including AI and Generative AI initiatives.
 



 The role will oversee multiple projects, strengthen delivery governance, manage client relationships, and drive resource and operational efficiency across the organization.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Own delivery across multiple projects, ensuring quality, consistency, predictability, and scalability.
* Track project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, dependencies, risks, and quality.
* Establish strong delivery governance and drive timely corrective actions.
* Manage critical escalations and ensure issues are resolved effectively.
* Work closely with engineering, architecture, product, QA, data, and AI teams.
* Oversee AI/GenAI projects involving experimentation, evolving requirements, evaluation, integrations, and production readiness.
* Build strong client relationships and manage expectations and delivery commitments.
* Identify account growth and expansion opportunities.
* Drive resource planning, allocation, utilization, hiring, and workforce planning.
* Monitor project profitability, delivery efficiency, and operational performance.
* Continuously improve delivery processes and organizational scalability.



  





  





 Required Skills and Experience
 


* 15\+ years of IT industry experience, including significant delivery and program management experience.
* Strong technical understanding of solution architecture, software engineering, integrations, cloud platforms, and delivery dependencies.
* Experience managing multiple complex technology and AI/GenAI projects.
* Strong knowledge of delivery governance, risk management, financial tracking, resource planning, and quality management.
* Experience managing senior client stakeholders and critical escalations.
* Strong leadership, communication, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills.

efffcc21.title: Program Manager Operations – Gujarat Apprenticeship
efffcc21.description:
**ROLE PURPOSE** 





 RightWalk Foundation works to solve socio\-economic inequality by co\-shaping and co\-designing public policy in Education, Livelihood and Health — converting policy into real, on\-ground outcomes in partnership with governments across India. Under the PMU – Gujarat Apprenticeship Mission, RightWalk drives large\-scale Job Readiness and Apprenticeship programmes for youth, using the Chatur AI Platform and Propel LMS to move students from training into employment.
 





 As Program Manager \- Operations, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of RightWalk's Job Readiness \& Apprenticeship programme in Gujarat — turning strategy into disciplined execution across institutions, government stakeholders and field teams. You will be the operational backbone ensuring programmes run on time, on budget, and with data you can defend — from student onboarding to placement.
 




**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. Programme Delivery** 



* Plan and execute Job Readiness / Apprenticeship programmes across partner ITIs and colleges.
* Drive student onboarding on Chatur AI and NAPS ID registration.
* Oversee baseline and endline assessments, and 10/20/30/60\-hour learning pathways.



**2\. Team \& Stakeholders** 



* Lead and mentor field coordinators and trainers on\-ground.
* Liaise with the PMU – Gujarat Apprenticeship Mission and government stakeholders.
* Build partnerships with institutions and industry for apprenticeship uptake.



**3\. MIS \& Quality** 



* Track KPIs — enrolment, attendance, assessment, conversion — on Propel LMS.
* Publish dashboards and reports for leadership, government and donors.
* Run quality audits and close the loop on field feedback.



**4\. Compliance \& Budget** 



* Ensure adherence to organisational and government compliance norms.
* Manage programme budgets, resourcing and vendor coordination.
* Build and institutionalise scalable SOPs.



**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 



* Education: Graduate / Postgraduate in Management, Social Work, Development Studies or a related field.
* Experience: 5–8 years in programme / operations management, preferably in education, skilling or livelihoods.
* Language: Fluent in English, Gujarati and Hindi; comfortable working with government offices.
* Core skills: Strong project and multi\-site programme management.
* Core skills: MIS, dashboards and advanced MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Core skills: Stakeholder and government liaison.
* Core skills: Team leadership and field capacity building.
* Core skills: Data\-driven, outcome\-oriented decision making.
* Core skills: Willingness to travel extensively across Gujarat.



**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Large\-scale impact on youth employability.
* A collaborative, mission\-driven culture.
* Direct exposure to government and policy systems.
* Compensation aligned to sector standards.


-

5693740e.title: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
5693740e.description:
**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi\-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
   

  

 You will take end\-to\-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi\-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
   

  

 Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best\-practices are applied, including: (1\) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2\) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3\) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
   

  

 In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. 🚀 Technical Program Lead – Sustainability \& Climate \| AWS \| GCP \| AWS→GCP Migration \| Remote India
   

  

 🔥 We’re AgileEngine!
   

  

 We’re hiring a Technical Program Lead to lead complex Sustainability \& Climate technology initiatives, including large\-scale AWS\-to\-GCP cloud migration and enterprise technology integration programs.
   

  

 This is a highly technical program leadership role — not a traditional PM, PMO, or project\-coordination position.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who is technically strong enough to understand architecture, challenge technical decisions, identify dependencies, and help unblock engineering teams when they get stuck.
   

  

 \-\-\-

 • Lead end\-to\-end technical programs across engineering, cloud, data and application teams
   

 • Drive AWS\-to\-GCP migration and complex technology integration initiatives
   

 • Work closely with engineering, cloud, data and architecture teams
   

 • Understand and manage technical workstreams, dependencies, risks and blockers
   

 • Engage deeply with architecture, APIs, integrations, databases and cloud services
   

 • Understand AWS→GCP service mapping and migration dependencies
   

 • Drive testing, validation, data reconciliation, cutover and production readiness
   

 • Help technically unblock teams and facilitate resolution of complex engineering issues
   

 • Manage stakeholder communication and executive\-level reporting
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 🚨 MUST\-HAVE
   

  

 • 10\+ years in Technical Program Management / Technical Delivery / Engineering Leadership
   

 • Strong technical depth — not a traditional PM/Delivery Manager profile
   

 • Experience delivering complex, multi\-team technical programs
   

 • Strong understanding of software architecture, application components, APIs, integrations and databases
   

 • Strong AWS \+ GCP knowledge
   

 • Hands\-on AWS→GCP migration experience — MUST\-HAVE
   

 • Ability to explain AWS→GCP service mapping, architecture, dependencies and migration decisions
   

 • Experience with migration planning, testing, validation, reconciliation, cutover and production readiness
   

 • Ability to work closely with engineers and technically unblock teams when issues arise
   

 • Strong technical risk, dependency and stakeholder management
   

 • Ability to communicate effectively with both engineers and senior/executive stakeholders
   

  

 \-\-\-

**Description**
 AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end\-to\-end products that surprise and delight out\-of\-the\-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
   

  

 We are optimizing the shopping experience for Amazon's Customers in the Physical retail space. This role will be a key member of the program team located in Hyderabad supporting Just Walk Out (JWO) tech and business teams. The successful candidate will be a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, with strong attention to detail, an ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-energy, and ever\-changing environment. The drive and capability to shape the business group strategy is a must. A successful candidate will:
   

  

* Have the ability to work independently in a broad array of environments.
* Manage cross\-functional project teams, planning, organizing, and executing complex projects across multiple organizations and stakeholders to enable the launch of new sites at scale.
* Build strong partnerships with operations leaders to understand improvement opportunities.
* Have the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Confidence operating in a highly ambiguous and iterative business space.
* High attention to detail including proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously.
* Willingness to challenge and influence senior leaders.
* Able to work in a diverse team


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop, review, approve, coordinate, and lead large strategic projects / programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and across different geographies.
* Build relationships and partner across cross\-functional teams to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders and partners to deliver on project goals. Coordinate a portfolio of programs from inception to delivery.
* Define and implement metrics to measure performance across procurement, operations, and transportation logistics.
* Compile, manage, and report on weekly project metrics and be responsible for leading meetings to align on project requirements.
* Communicate program status updates to the stakeholders and senior leadership on a regular basis.
* Provide program insights and data driven recommendations to support strategic decisions.


**About The Team**
 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience

* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables \& charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Technical Program Manager – AI\-Enabled Engineering Pods
   

  

 Role Title: Technical Program Manager – Full Stack, Cloud \& AI Engineering
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Experience Required: Minimum 14\+ years of experience
   

  

 We are looking for a seasoned
 **Technical Program Manager** 
 to lead and manage multiple cross\-functional engineering pod teams based in Hyderabad. This role requires strong technical depth, hands\-on understanding of modern full stack engineering practices, cloud\-native platforms, DevSecOps, and practical experience using AI and Gen AI platforms to improve engineering productivity, delivery predictability, quality, and operational excellence.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have prior experience managing complex technology programs involving distributed engineering teams, product owners, architects, developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders. The candidate must be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels — driving roadmap alignment, technical delivery, architecture discussions, release governance, dependency management, risk mitigation, and executive\-level reporting.
   

  

 This is not a pure project management role. The candidate is expected to bring strong technical judgment, understand engineering trade\-offs, challenge solution approaches where required, and guide teams toward scalable, secure, maintainable, and AI\-enabled delivery practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program \& Delivery Leadership**
* Lead multiple engineering pod teams delivering full stack, cloud\-native, and enterprise\-grade digital applications.
* Own end\-to\-end program execution across planning, design, development, testing, release, deployment, and production support.
* Drive delivery predictability across multiple pods by managing scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, milestones, and release commitments.
* Partner with product owners, architects, engineering managers, QA leads, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure successful execution.
* Establish clear operating rhythms across sprint planning, backlog refinement, architecture reviews, dependency tracking, release planning, and production readiness.
* Monitor execution health across pods and proactively address blockers, capacity gaps, technical risks, and cross\-team dependencies.
* Drive alignment between business objectives, product priorities, technical architecture, and delivery execution.
* Ensure programs are delivered with strong focus on quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational stability.


**Technical Program Management**
* Facilitate technical design discussions across .NET Core, Angular, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, DevSecOps, and integration platforms.
* Partner with architects and senior engineers to validate solution approaches, identify architectural risks, and ensure adherence to enterprise standards.
* Drive technical governance across application architecture, API design, cloud integration, security, performance, observability, and deployment practices.
* Ensure engineering teams follow clean architecture, SOLID principles, secure coding practices, CI/CD standards, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Track and manage technical debt, platform modernization initiatives, production stability issues, and engineering improvement plans.
* Support teams in resolving production issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, cloud services, and deployment pipelines.
* Ensure delivery teams adopt appropriate engineering metrics, including sprint predictability, defect leakage, deployment frequency, change failure rate, code quality, test coverage, and production incident trends.


**AI \& Gen AI Enablement**
* Drive responsible adoption of AI and Gen AI tools across engineering pods to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, and problem\-solving.
* Enable teams to use platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or similar enterprise\-approved AI platforms.
* Identify practical AI use cases across software delivery, including code generation, refactoring, unit test generation, API documentation, technical design documentation, defect analysis, and security review support.
* Establish AI usage guardrails aligned with enterprise security, data privacy, compliance, intellectual property, and responsible AI policies.
* Partner with engineering and security teams to evaluate AI\-assisted development workflows and ensure safe adoption.
* Track productivity and quality improvements resulting from AI\-enabled engineering practices.
* Promote a culture of AI\-assisted engineering while ensuring human accountability for design, code quality, security, and production outcomes.


**Agile, DevSecOps \& Release Governance**
* Lead agile execution across multiple pods using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* Drive consistent sprint ceremonies, backlog hygiene, estimation practices, release planning, and execution governance.
* Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, quality gates, code reviews, test automation, security scans, and release approvals are integrated into delivery workflows.
* Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve deployment reliability, environment stability, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
* Ensure production releases meet defined entry and exit criteria, including quality, security, performance, and operational readiness checks.
* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, agile maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and delivery effectiveness.


**Stakeholder \& Executive Communication**
* Provide clear, concise, and data\-driven program updates to senior leadership, including Directors, VPs, and CXO\-level stakeholders where required.
* Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, financial impacts, delivery trade\-offs, and mitigation plans with appropriate executive clarity.
* Prepare roadmap views, release dashboards, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and program health reports.
* Translate complex technical topics into business\-relevant insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Drive decision\-making across competing priorities, delivery constraints, architecture options, and risk scenarios.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Minimum 14\+ years of overall technology experience, with strong background in software engineering, technical delivery, program management, or engineering leadership.
* Proven experience managing multiple engineering pods or cross\-functional agile teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong technical understanding of full stack application delivery using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, Angular, C\#, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, backend services, cloud\-native application patterns, and scalable web architectures.
* Experience working with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Good understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, Git\-based workflows, automated deployment, and production release governance.
* Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Practical experience using AI or Gen AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery models, sprint execution, roadmap planning, dependency management, and engineering metrics.
* Ability to challenge technical assumptions, identify delivery risks, and drive resolution across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, security, and business teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to engage senior leadership and technical teams with equal effectiveness.


**Preferred Technical Capabilities**
* Prior hands\-on software engineering experience before moving into technical program management or engineering leadership.
* Experience managing enterprise\-scale modernization, cloud migration, platform transformation, or digital product engineering programs.
* Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, insurance, life sciences, or other compliance\-heavy environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture governance, security reviews, audit requirements, and compliance controls.
* Experience with observability platforms, production support models, SRE practices, and incident management.
* Experience implementing AI\-assisted SDLC practices across large engineering teams.
* Understanding of responsible AI, AI governance, data privacy, secure prompt usage, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.


**AI Platform Expectations**
 The candidate should be hands\-on and comfortable using AI platforms to:
   

  

* Improve engineering productivity across multiple pod teams.
* Assist with code review, code generation, and refactoring analysis.
* Generate unit test cases and improve test coverage.
* Support API documentation, architecture documentation, and technical design documentation.
* Analyze technical designs, logs, defects, and production issues for faster triage.
* Identify security, performance, and maintainability concerns in application delivery.
* Build reusable AI\-enabled workflows for engineering teams.
* Promote responsible AI adoption in alignment with enterprise policies.
* Ensure AI tools are used as productivity accelerators while preserving engineering accountability, security, and compliance.


**Leadership \& Soft Skills**
* Strong ownership mindset with ability to operate independently in a senior leadership\-facing role.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to lead multiple teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and complex dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to balance delivery speed with technical quality, security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Strong communication skills with ability to simplify complex technical issues for executive audiences.
* Ability to mentor pod leads, scrum masters, technical leads, and engineering teams on delivery discipline and engineering best practices.
* Strong execution discipline with focus on measurable outcomes, delivery transparency, and continuous improvement.


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.
